sources.title: Food Standards Scotland · Online allergen training: staff communication

examples.en: Could you tell me what is in this dish, including the sauce?
examples.zh: 能告诉我这道菜有哪些食材吗？也请包括酱汁的配料。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
客人对服务员：食材说明；例句不保证任何菜没有某种过敏原。

entries.en: Does this come with a side dish?

definition.en: A question about accompaniments supplied with a dish.
definition.zh: come with 在菜单语境中表示随主菜一起提供。客人用它确认是否有配菜；如果费用不明确，应再核对配菜是否包含在标价内。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Does this come with a side dish, or should I order one separately?
examples.zh: 这道菜配有配菜吗，还是我需要另外点一份？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
客人对服务员：询问菜品组成；未把 come with 的所有含义合并到餐饮场景。

definition.en: A question about the strength of a dish’s chilli heat.
definition.zh: 询问辣度而不是泛指香料是否丰富。服务员可说明辣味来自哪里、是否可调整，避免把个人觉得“不辣”当成每位客人的感受。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services
British Council · Requests, offers and invitations

examples.en: How spicy is this dish? I would prefer something with only a little chilli.
examples.zh: 这道菜有多辣？我想吃只有一点辣椒的。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
客人对服务员：菜品风味沟通；例句使用可理解的偏好说明。

entries.en: Let me check with the kitchen.

definition.en: An offer to verify information with the kitchen team.
definition.zh: 遇到配料、做法或出餐时间不确定时，先向厨房核实再答复。check with someone 表示找有关人员确认；不是已经承诺厨房能够满足要求。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
Food Standards Scotland · Online allergen training: staff communication

examples.en: Let me check with the kitchen before I confirm whether the sauce can be changed.
examples.zh: 让我先向厨房确认，再答复您酱汁是否可以更换。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：先核实，再作答。

entries.en: Could you tell me what you need to avoid?
entries.zh: 能告诉我您需要避开什么吗？

definition.en: A polite question to clarify a guest’s food restrictions.
definition.zh: 在饮食需求已经提出后，进一步确认需要避开的具体食物或成分。客人若说明过敏或不耐受，应准确传达给相关同事，并核实制作信息。

sources.title: Food Standards Scotland · Online allergen training: staff communication

examples.en: Could you tell me what you need to avoid? I will pass the details to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 能告诉我您需要避开什么吗？我会把具体情况转达给厨房。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：澄清要求，不判断过敏程度，也不作绝对安全保证。

entries.en: Could you check the preparation time?
entries.zh: 能确认一下制作需要多久吗？

definition.en: A request for an updated estimate of how long preparation will take.
definition.zh: 服务人员向厨房或同事确认一道菜预计还需多久。preparation time 是备制时间；向客人报告时还应考虑装盘和送餐所需时间。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could you check the preparation time for table twelve’s main courses?
examples.zh: 能确认一下十二桌主菜的制作时间吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对厨房或同事：核实时间，不编造等待分钟数。

entries.en: Could we serve the starters first?

definition.en: A request to arrange the order in which courses are served.
definition.zh: 用于与厨房或领班协调先上前菜，再上后续菜品。serve 在这里是供应、上菜；first 表示顺序，不是要求某桌抢先。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could we serve the starters first and bring the main courses when the guests are ready?
examples.zh: 我们可以先上前菜，等客人准备好再上主菜吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
内部服务协调：明确上菜顺序。

entries.en: Could you bring out the dishes together?

definition.en: A request to coordinate dishes so they reach the table together.
definition.zh: 要求同事协调送菜，让相关菜品同时到桌。bring out 在这里是从厨房送到用餐区；可补充桌号和菜品，避免指代不清。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could you bring out the dishes for table six together? They would like to eat at the same time.
examples.zh: 能把六桌的菜一起上吗？他们想同时开始用餐。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
内部服务协调：与“先上前菜”的分道上菜意图不同。

entries.en: Could you hold the main courses?

definition.en: A request to pause the main-course service.
definition.zh: 在与厨房沟通时，hold 表示暂缓某项动作。应说明是在暂缓开始制作还是暂缓出餐，以及何时再确认；不要把这句话当作取消订单。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English

examples.en: Could you hold the main courses for table four? They are still enjoying their starters.
examples.zh: 能暂缓上四桌的主菜吗？他们还在吃前菜。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
内部服务协调：按餐厅流程明确 hold 的具体环节；不是让热食无限等待。

entries.zh: 能推荐一个替代选择吗？

definition.en: A request for another suitable option.
definition.zh: 原选择缺货、不合口味或不能满足要求时，请服务员推荐其他选项。alternative 只是替代选项，是否符合饮食限制、预算和口味仍需核实。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could you recommend an alternative with a similar flavour and price?
examples.zh: 能推荐一道风味和价格相近的替代选择吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
客人对服务员：提出替代方案的具体条件。

entries.en: I'm afraid that is not available today.

definition.en: A courteous way to explain that an item cannot be offered today.
definition.zh: I’m afraid 在这里用于委婉告知不如人愿的消息，不表示害怕。说明今天无法供应后，可接着介绍已经确认的替代选择。

sources.title: British Council · Ordering in a café

examples.en: I'm afraid that is not available today. Would you like to hear about another option?
examples.zh: 很抱歉，今天没有这个。您想听听其他选择吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：说明供应情况；不与既有 run out of 词条混作相同含义。

definition.en: An expression of appreciation when a guest has had to wait.
definition.zh: 客人等候或配合处理问题后表示感谢。patience 指耐心，不是 patients（病人）；必要时再接具体进度，让感谢有实际回应。

sources.title: British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Thank you for your patience. The kitchen has confirmed that your main courses are being plated.
examples.zh: 谢谢您的耐心等待。厨房刚确认，您的主菜正在装盘。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：只有核实进度后才使用例句中的状态。

entries.en: It should be ready in about ten minutes.
entries.zh: 预计大约十分钟后就好。

definition.en: An estimated completion time, rather than an absolute promise.
definition.zh: should 在这里表示合理预计，in about ten minutes 表示大约十分钟后。实际使用时用厨房刚确认的时间替换 ten minutes，情况变化后再更新。

examples.en: It should be ready in about ten minutes, according to the kitchen’s latest estimate.
examples.zh: 按照厨房刚给的预估，大约十分钟后就好。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：时间只是示例，不是所有菜品的标准时长。

entries.en: Would you mind waiting a little longer?

definition.en: A considerate request for some additional waiting time.
definition.zh: would you mind 后接动词 -ing，因此是 waiting。字面在问“是否介意”；回答 No, not at all 通常表示愿意等，不能把 yes/no 机械对应成同意或拒绝。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary · Would: requests and offers
British Council · How to be polite in English

examples.en: Would you mind waiting a little longer while I get an accurate update from the kitchen?
examples.zh: 我去向厨房确认准确进度，您介意再等一会儿吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：应给客人选择，而不是用礼貌句强迫等待。

entries.en: Could you tell me what went wrong?
entries.zh: 能告诉我哪里出了问题吗？

definition.en: A calm question inviting a guest to explain a problem.
definition.zh: 处理投诉时，请客人说明发生了什么，以便找准问题。what went wrong 是间接问句；先听完整说明，再确认自己理解是否正确。

sources.title: British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Could you tell me what went wrong with your order so I can help?
examples.zh: 能告诉我您的点单哪里出了问题吗？这样我可以帮您处理。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：了解问题，不预先指责客人或同事。

definition.en: An apology for a mistake or confusion in arrangements.
definition.zh: mix-up 是名词，指弄混或安排上的差错，例如送错桌、记错点单。先说明已确认的错误，再提出实际能做到的处理方式。

examples.en: I'm sorry about the mix-up. I brought the wrong side dish, and I will correct it.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，刚才弄错了。我送错了配菜，会为您更正。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：mix-up 名词与 mix up 动词短语分开理解。

entries.en: Would you like me to replace it?

definition.en: An offer to replace an unsatisfactory or incorrect item.
definition.zh: Would you like me to 后接动词原形，用来询问客人是否希望由你执行某个动作。replace it 是换掉目前这份，不等于自行承诺退款或免单。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary · Would: requests and offers
British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Would you like me to replace it with a fresh portion? I can check the waiting time first.
examples.zh: 您希望我为您换一份新的吗？我可以先确认需要等多久。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：替换方案应符合餐厅授权并经客人同意。

entries.en: Let me speak to the manager.

definition.en: An offer to involve the manager when further help is needed.
definition.zh: 需要主管授权或更多协助时，说明自己将找经理沟通。let me 后直接接动词原形；不是让客人自己去找经理，也不预设经理一定批准某项补偿。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Let me speak to the manager about your request, and I will come back with an answer.
examples.zh: 让我就您的要求跟经理沟通一下，然后回来答复您。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：明确下一步行动，不先承诺尚未获准的结果。

entries.en: Could we move to another table?
entries.zh: 我们可以换一张桌子吗？

definition.en: A polite request to change tables.
definition.zh: 客人希望换桌时使用。another table 指另一张桌子；服务员应确认可用桌位、预订及客人需求后安排。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English

examples.en: Could we move to another table farther from the door?
examples.zh: 我们可以换到离门远一点的桌子吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
客人对服务员：座位调整。

entries.zh: 我可以把这些餐盘收走吗？

definition.en: A request for permission to remove used plates.
definition.zh: 服务员收餐盘前征求同意。clear 在这里表示撤走餐具，不是清洗或把菜吃光；问句中的 these plates 要与实际准备撤走的盘子一致。

sources.title: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary · Clear: remove plates
British Council · Requests, offers and invitations

examples.en: Can I clear these plates, or are you still enjoying the food?
examples.zh: 我可以把这些餐盘收走吗，还是您还在用餐？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：先征求同意，不用客人交叉摆放餐具等单一线索代替确认。

definition.en: An offer of further food, drink or assistance.
definition.zh: 一轮服务完成后询问是否还需要其他东西。anything else 表示除此之外还有什么；可结合场景补充 dessert、coffee 或其他实际可提供的选项。

sources.title: British Council · Requests, offers and invitations
British Council · Ordering in a café

examples.en: Would you like anything else before I bring the dessert menu?
examples.zh: 在我拿甜品菜单之前，您还需要别的吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
服务员对客人：提供后续服务，语气自然即可。

entries.en: Could we have the bill, please?

definition.en: A polite request for the restaurant bill.
definition.zh: 客人在结账时请求账单。英国英语常说 bill，美国餐厅也常说 check；这是付款前的消费账单，不等同于付款后的 receipt。

examples.en: Could we have the bill, please? We would like to check it before paying.
examples.zh: 麻烦给我们账单。我们想在付款前核对一下。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menus / service expansion · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Original teaching explanation and example; linked sources verify the expression or grammatical pattern.
客人对服务员：未将 bill、check 或 receipt 单词加入本句别名，避免多义冲突。

definition.en: Spaghetti tossed in a tomato sauce with olives, capers and garlic; many versions also include anchovies and chilli.
definition.zh: 长意面拌番茄、橄榄、酸豆和蒜制成的酱汁，风味咸鲜；不少版本加入凤尾鱼和辣椒。介绍菜品时应说明本店是否使用凤尾鱼，而不能仅凭番茄酱外观判断。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — spaghetti alla puttanesca

examples.en: Our puttanesca has a tomato sauce with olives, capers and anchovies.
examples.zh: 我们的这款意面配番茄酱，里面有橄榄、酸豆和凤尾鱼。

definition.en: Penne coated in a tomato sauce whose heat comes from chilli, with garlic and olive oil.
definition.zh: 斜管面搭配以番茄、蒜、橄榄油和辣椒为基础的辣酱。Arrabbiata 指这类辣番茄做法，实际辣度取决于厨师用量；不同餐厅也可能改变配面或撒上的奶酪。

examples.en: The penne all’arrabbiata has a spicy tomato sauce; I can check how hot today’s batch is.
examples.zh: 这道通心粉用的是辣番茄酱；我可以确认一下今天这批酱的辣度。

Do not treat arrabbiata alone, a sauce style, as an exact alias for the plated penne dish.

definition.en: Large pasta tubes filled with meat ragù, covered with sauce and cheese, and baked.
definition.zh: 将肉酱填进粗管意面或卷起的面皮，再加酱汁和奶酪焗烤；常见牛肉版本会用贝夏梅尔白酱。Cannelloni 仅说明面卷形态，di carne 才说明这里是肉馅，不能将菠菜奶酪版一并解释为肉馅。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — cannelloni di carne

examples.en: The cannelloni are filled with meat ragù and baked under béchamel and Parmesan.
examples.zh: 这款面卷填入肉酱，上面覆盖贝夏梅尔白酱和帕尔马干酪后焗烤。

Root review: omitted beef-only alias from the broader meat-filled category; example explicitly describes one beef preparation.

definition.en: Filled pasta parcels containing ricotta and spinach, served with a sauce chosen by the kitchen.
definition.zh: 用薄面皮包裹瑞可塔奶酪与菠菜馅的意式饺，馅中也常有硬质奶酪和肉豆蔻。这里说明的是馅料组合，番茄酱、黄油等搭配酱汁需要另行确认；ravioli 本身并不限定这种馅。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — ravioli ricotta e spinaci

examples.en: These ravioli have a spinach and ricotta filling, with tomato and basil sauce.
examples.zh: 这些意式饺里面是菠菜和瑞可塔奶酪，搭配番茄罗勒酱。

definition.en: Ligurian filled pasta with greens and cheese, served with a walnut sauce.
definition.zh: 利古里亚的饱满馅面，常见三角形，内馅由绿叶菜、香草和奶酪组成，配核桃酱。野菜组合和替代用的菠菜、莙荙菜会因配方而异；菜名中的 salsa di noci 明确指出核桃酱。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — pansotti con salsa di noci

examples.en: The pansotti are filled with greens and cheese, and the sauce is made with walnuts.
examples.zh: 这道馅面的内馅是绿叶菜和奶酪，酱汁由核桃制成。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

Pansotti alone is not used as an alias for this specific sauce pairing.

definition.en: A Milanese risotto coloured and flavoured with saffron, traditionally enriched with butter, cheese and often bone marrow.
definition.zh: 米兰式烩饭以藏红花带来的金黄色和香气为识别特点，常以黄油、奶酪增添浓郁感；传统配方可用骨髓与牛肉高汤。它是 risotto 的具体做法，不能把所有烩饭都解释为藏红花烩饭。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — risotto alla Milanese

examples.en: The golden colour comes from saffron; this version is also made with beef stock.
examples.zh: 它的金黄色来自藏红花；这一版本也用了牛肉高汤。

definition.en: Fried sardines marinated with softened onions and vinegar, sometimes with raisins and pine nuts.
definition.zh: 先将沙丁鱼炸熟，再与炒软的洋葱和醋汁层叠腌渍的威尼斯菜，风味酸甜。葡萄干、松子或葡萄酒属于不同版本的变化；这不是直接用酸汁腌生鱼的做法。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — sarde in saor

examples.en: The sardines are fried first, then marinated with onions and vinegar.
examples.zh: 沙丁鱼会先炸熟，再与洋葱和醋汁一起腌入味。

definition.en: Cooked preserved cod whipped with oil into a light spread, traditionally served with polenta.
definition.zh: 把泡发并煮熟的鳕鱼与油逐渐搅打成蓬松鱼泥，常配软玉米糊或烤玉米糕。威尼斯传统所说的 baccalà 可指未盐腌的风干鳕鱼 stockfish；其他做法也会用盐鳕鱼或牛奶，不能把 creamy 自动理解成加了奶油。

sources.title: Dogale Confraternita del Baccalà Mantecato — The Original Recipe

examples.en: The baccalà mantecato is a light whipped cod spread served with grilled polenta.
examples.zh: 这道威尼斯鳕鱼泥口感蓬松，搭配烤玉米糕。

entries.zh: 皮埃蒙特蒜香凤尾鱼暖蘸酱

definition.en: A warm Piedmontese anchovy, garlic and oil dip, served with vegetables.
definition.zh: 皮埃蒙特将凤尾鱼、蒜和油慢慢加热成温热蘸酱，配生蔬菜或熟蔬菜食用；有的配方加入黄油或用牛奶处理蒜。它虽然配蔬菜，酱里却有鱼类成分，介绍时要明确。

examples.en: The vegetables come with a warm garlic and anchovy dip called bagna cauda.
examples.zh: 蔬菜配的是温热蒜香凤尾鱼蘸酱，叫 bagna cauda。

definition.en: Soft polenta enriched with melted cheese and butter; the Aosta Valley version commonly uses Fontina.
definition.zh: 煮好的玉米糊拌入奶酪和黄油，质地柔滑浓郁，可作配菜或较饱腹的主食。奥斯塔谷常用 Fontina，其他地方可能选不同奶酪；这不是所有 polenta 都必有的配方。

examples.en: Our polenta concia is soft and creamy, with melted Fontina and butter.
examples.zh: 我们的奶酪玉米糊质地柔滑，加入了融化的芳提娜奶酪和黄油。

definition.en: Crisp fried pastry tubes filled with sweetened ricotta, with toppings that vary.
definition.zh: 把薄面皮卷成管状炸脆，再填入甜瑞可塔奶酪馅的西西里甜点，常有巧克力、蜜饯果皮或开心果等变化。外壳和馅分开制作，临近上桌填馅有助于保留脆感；cannolo 是单数。

examples.en: The cannoli have crisp pastry shells and a sweet ricotta filling.
examples.zh: 这些奶酪酥卷有酥脆的外壳，里面填的是甜瑞可塔奶酪。

definition.en: Shell-shaped Neapolitan pastries with crisp layers and a sweet ricotta-and-semolina filling.
definition.zh: 那不勒斯的贝壳形甜酥点，ricce 指层层展开的脆皮版本，通常包入瑞可塔、粗粒小麦粉和糖渍果皮馅。需要与使用甜酥派皮的 sfogliatelle frolle 区分；制皮脂肪也可能用猪油，不能单凭甜点外观判断。

sources.title: GialloZafferano — Easy Sfogliatelle; ricce and frolle distinction

examples.en: The sfogliatelle ricce have crisp layers around a ricotta and semolina filling.
examples.zh: 这款千层贝壳酥的脆皮包着瑞可塔奶酪和粗粒小麦粉馅。

entries.zh: 西西里瑞可塔夹心蛋糕

definition.en: A Sicilian sponge-and-ricotta cake commonly finished with marzipan, icing and candied fruit.
definition.zh: 海绵蛋糕与甜瑞可塔奶酪组合的西西里甜点，常用杏仁糖膏、糖霜和蜜饯水果装饰。馅料可能含巧克力，蛋糕或奶酪馅也可能加入利口酒；这里指蛋糕做法，而不是所有也叫 cassata 的冷冻甜品。

examples.en: This cassata layers sponge cake with ricotta and has a marzipan finish.
examples.zh: 这款卡萨塔将海绵蛋糕与瑞可塔奶酪叠在一起，外面有杏仁糖膏。

entries.zh: 托斯卡纳番茄面包浓汤

definition.en: A thick Tuscan soup of tomatoes and bread, flavoured with basil, garlic and olive oil.
definition.zh: 托斯卡纳以面包、番茄、罗勒、蒜和橄榄油煮成的浓汤；面包在汤中吸汁并煮散，所以质地很稠。它可以温热或放凉后供应，服务时应说明本店温度，不能只译成普通番茄汤。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — pappa al pomodoro

examples.en: The pappa al pomodoro is thickened with bread and finished with basil and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这道番茄浓汤用面包增加稠度，最后加入罗勒和橄榄油。

definition.en: A Tuscan bread salad with tomatoes, onion, basil and an oil-and-vinegar dressing.
definition.zh: 以面包吸收番茄汁、油醋汁，搭配番茄、洋葱和罗勒的沙拉，常见于托斯卡纳。传统会把稍干的面包浸软后挤干，现代版本也可烤脆；黄瓜等配料随配方变化。

examples.en: The panzanella combines tomatoes, basil and bread that absorbs the dressing.
examples.zh: 这道面包沙拉有番茄和罗勒，面包会吸收调味汁。

definition.en: Boneless pork seasoned with herbs and garlic, rolled or prepared as a whole roast, then roasted and sliced.
definition.zh: 去骨猪肉以蒜和香草调味后烤制，常见有猪皮的卷状大块，切片供应或夹入面包。茴香、迷迭香及所用部位因地区和餐厅而异；它是烤肉，不能与风干火腿 prosciutto 混同。

examples.en: The porchetta is sliced roast pork with a crisp skin and fragrant herbs.
examples.zh: 这道意式烤猪肉会切片上桌，带脆皮和香草风味。

definition.en: Layers of cooked aubergine, tomato sauce and cheese baked together.
definition.zh: 将茄子片与番茄酱、奶酪层叠焗烤，常用马苏里拉和帕尔马干酪。茄子通常先炸，也有烤制版本；它不含意面层，不能因为外观层叠就称为 lasagne。

sources.title: The Italian Chef — Parmigiana di Melanzane

examples.en: The parmigiana is layered aubergine baked with tomato sauce and cheese.
examples.zh: 这道焗茄子是把茄子、番茄酱和奶酪分层铺好后烤制。

entries.zh: 意式酒香蛋黄泡沫甜点

definition.en: An airy custard made by whisking egg yolks, sugar and wine over gentle heat, often using Marsala.
definition.zh: 把蛋黄、糖和葡萄酒隔水轻柔加热并不断打发，形成蓬松细腻的甜点或甜酱，常用马沙拉酒。可单独装杯或配水果；服务时应说明用酒，不应把加热视为无酒精保证。

examples.en: The zabaglione is a light egg-yolk dessert made with Marsala wine.
examples.zh: 这道甜点是用蛋黄打发制成的，口感轻盈，加入了马沙拉酒。

entries.zh: 威尼斯式洋葱炒小牛肝

definition.en: Calf’s liver cooked with softened onions, a classic Venetian combination.
definition.zh: 以小牛肝和炒软的洋葱为主的威尼斯菜，洋葱甜味与肝脏的浓郁风味相配；常用黄油、油及欧芹，有的版本以酒或醋调味，并配玉米糊。Fegato 指肝脏，需要清楚告知客人这是一道内脏菜。

sources.title: Ristorante Marciana Venice — Fegato alla Veneziana
Chef Gian Petro Ferro — Fegato alla Veneziana, La Cucina Italiana

examples.en: The fegato alla Veneziana is calf’s liver with softened onions, served here with polenta.
examples.zh: 这道威尼斯式小牛肝搭配炒软的洋葱，我们这里配玉米糊供应。

entries.zh: 罗马式焗粗粒小麦圆饼

definition.en: Semolina cooked with milk, cooled and cut into discs, then baked with butter and cheese.
definition.zh: 粗粒小麦粉与牛奶煮稠，冷却后切成圆片，再加黄油和奶酪焗烤。它虽叫 gnocchi，却不是常见的土豆面团小丸子；圆片的表面可烤成金黄，配菜由餐厅决定。

sources.title: Chef Giovanni Rota — Gnocchi alla Romana, La Cucina Italiana cooking school

examples.en: These Roman-style gnocchi are baked semolina discs with butter and cheese.
examples.zh: 这款罗马式 gnocchi 是用粗粒小麦粉做的圆片，加黄油和奶酪焗烤。

Specific dish distinct from the existing gnocchi alla Sorrentina.

definition.en: Ear-shaped pasta tossed with broccoli rabe, garlic and olive oil, with chilli and other seasonings varying by recipe.
definition.zh: 普利亚常见的耳朵形意面与 cime di rapa 绿叶菜同煮或拌炒，搭配蒜、橄榄油及辣椒。英语菜单常把该菜写成 broccoli rabe 或 rapini，不是普通西兰花花球；某些版本还用凤尾鱼或奶酪。

sources.title: Eataly — Orecchiette con Cime di Rapa
Great British Chefs — How to Make Orecchiette Pasta

examples.en: The orecchiette are tossed with broccoli rabe, garlic and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这道猫耳朵面拌有芜菁嫩叶、蒜和橄榄油。

entries.zh: 瓦尔泰利纳奶酪荞麦面

definition.en: Buckwheat pasta cooked with potatoes and greens, then layered with cheese and dressed with garlic butter.
definition.zh: 北意瓦尔泰利纳的短条荞麦面，与土豆和卷心菜等绿叶菜同煮，再与当地奶酪、蒜香黄油组合。传统面团也含普通小麦粉，因此不能仅因名称有荞麦就承诺无麸质；绿叶菜会按季节替换。

sources.title: Accademia del Pizzocchero di Teglio — La ricetta originale

examples.en: The pizzoccheri combine buckwheat pasta, potatoes, cabbage and melted cheese.
examples.zh: 这道瓦尔泰利纳荞麦面有土豆、卷心菜和融化的奶酪。

Accademia recipe checks flour blend and seasonal greens; broad pasta name alone is not an alias.

definition.en: Pasta parcels filled with pumpkin; the Mantuan style often adds amaretti, cheese and fruit mostarda.
definition.zh: 南瓜馅的意式面饺，曼托瓦风格常在馅内加入杏仁饼干、奶酪和带芥末辛香的水果蜜饯 mostarda，呈甜咸交织的风味。不同地区的南瓜馅配方会变化，不能把杏仁饼干或 mostarda 当成所有版本的必备。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — tortelli di zucca

examples.en: The pumpkin tortelli have a sweet-savoury filling and are finished with melted butter.
examples.zh: 这道南瓜意式饺的馅料带甜咸风味，最后淋上融化的黄油。

Mostarda is not translated as ordinary mustard sauce; tortelli is not replaced by generic ravioli.

definition.en: Tiny pinched pasta parcels from Piedmont, often filled with cooked meat and vegetables and served with butter or meat juices.
definition.zh: 皮埃蒙特的小型捏褶馅面，plin 体现制作时捏合面皮的动作。常见馅料有熟肉和蔬菜，配黄油或炖肉汁；当地没有唯一固定馅料，点单介绍时应补充本店所用肉类与酱汁。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — agnolotti del plin

examples.en: These agnolotti del plin are filled with braised beef and cabbage.
examples.zh: 这款皮埃蒙特小馅面填的是炖牛肉和卷心菜。

Recipe variability is explicit; generic agnolotti is not an exact alias.

definition.en: Soft ricotta-based dumplings, sometimes with leafy greens, cooked without an enclosing pasta sheet.
definition.zh: 以瑞可塔奶酪为基础的柔软团子，可加入菠菜等绿叶菜，通常水煮后配黄油或其他酱汁。常被形容为没有外层面皮的意式饺馅；即使没有面皮，配方仍可能有面粉、面包屑或粗粒小麦粉。

examples.en: The gnudi are delicate ricotta dumplings, served with sage butter.
examples.zh: 这道 gnudi 是柔软的瑞可塔奶酪团子，配鼠尾草黄油。

No pasta wrapper does not imply gluten-free.

definition.en: Whole trimmed artichokes gently cooked with garlic, herbs, oil and a little liquid.
definition.zh: 把修整好的洋蓟填入蒜、欧芹、mentuccia 等香草调味，在锅中以油和少量液体慢慢焖软。口感柔嫩，区别于油炸酥脆的 carciofi alla giudia；所用酒和香草组合需按餐厅配方描述。

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Carciofi! Alla giudìa o alla romana?

examples.en: The artichokes alla Romana are gently braised with garlic and herbs.
examples.zh: 这道罗马式洋蓟用蒜和香草慢慢焖至柔嫩。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-26. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
Keep distinct from carciofi alla giudia.

definition.en: Trimmed artichokes deep-fried until the leaves are crisp and the centre is tender.
definition.zh: 罗马犹太饮食传统中的炸洋蓟，修整后整颗下锅，叶片展开形成花朵状，外层酥脆而中心柔软。这里的 giudia 标示菜式传统，不等于餐厅具有任何宗教饮食认证；与焖煮的 alla Romana 是两道菜。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — carciofi alla giudia

examples.en: The artichokes alla giudia are fried, with crisp leaves and a tender heart.
examples.zh: 这道犹太式洋蓟是炸制的，叶片酥脆，中心柔嫩。

The culinary name is not a kosher-certification claim.

definition.en: Squash or courgette flowers filled with a savoury mixture, then fried or baked.
definition.zh: 将可食用的瓜花填入咸味馅料后炸或烤，常见奶酪、凤尾鱼组合，也有其他版本。Ripieni 只表示填馅，不能由菜名推断一定没有鱼或肉；服务时应说明馅料和烹调方式。

examples.en: The courgette flowers are stuffed with ricotta and anchovy, then fried until crisp.
examples.zh: 这些西葫芦花填入瑞可塔和凤尾鱼后炸至酥脆。

Avoid the broad unstuffed flower name as an alias.

definition.en: A hearty Tuscan fish-and-seafood stew, commonly tomato-based and served with garlic-rubbed toast.
definition.zh: 托斯卡纳沿海的浓炖鱼汤，以利沃诺风格尤为常见，通常加入番茄，按不同烹调时间下入鱼、头足类和其他海鲜，配擦蒜烤面包。所用渔获与配方会变化，介绍时要说清当天海鲜，不能承诺固定鱼种或无刺。

examples.en: The cacciucco is a rich seafood stew served over garlic-rubbed toast; I can explain today’s fish selection.
examples.zh: 这道浓炖海鲜汤配擦蒜烤面包；我可以为您介绍今天使用的鱼类。

entries.zh: 那不勒斯麦粒瑞可塔甜派

definition.en: A Neapolitan pastry tart filled with ricotta, cooked wheat, candied citrus and orange-blossom flavouring.
definition.zh: 那不勒斯传统甜派，用酥皮包裹瑞可塔奶酪、煮熟麦粒、蜜饯柑橘皮和橙花香气的馅料，常见于复活节。麦粒带来细碎颗粒感；也存在替换谷物的版本，不能只把它介绍成普通芝士蛋糕。

examples.en: The pastiera has a ricotta and wheat filling with a delicate orange-blossom aroma.
examples.zh: 这道甜派里面是瑞可塔奶酪和麦粒馅，带柔和的橙花香。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-26. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
Original wheat-based identity distinguished from rice substitutions.

definition.en: A bistro salad of leaves, bacon pieces and egg, commonly finished with croutons and a sharp dressing.
definition.zh: 里昂小酒馆常见的沙拉，以叶菜、培根丁和鸡蛋构成，常配脆面包丁与带酸味的沙拉汁。常见版本用卷叶菊苣和水波蛋；其他版本也会用煮蛋，不能把所有沙拉配方视为相同。

examples.en: Our Lyonnaise salad comes with crisp bacon, a poached egg and a tangy dressing.
examples.zh: 我们的里昂沙拉配脆培根、水波蛋和带酸味的沙拉汁。

reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Official Lyon recipe uses boiled eggs and quenelle slices; chef recipe verifies the poached-egg presentation. Optional garnishes are not universal ingredients.

aliases: poached eggs in red wine sauce

definition.en: Poached eggs served with a reduced wine sauce, classically red wine with bacon and shallots.
definition.zh: 勃艮第经典蛋料理，水波蛋配收浓的葡萄酒酱汁；常见红酒版本带有培根丁、红葱头，有时加入蘑菇，并配烤面包。Meurette 指酱汁风格，不能把菜名直接等同于所有水波蛋。

examples.en: The eggs are poached and served with a red wine sauce containing bacon and shallots.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋以水波方式烹调，配含培根和红葱头的红酒酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Red-wine version is presented as classical, not the only version; cooking with wine does not establish an alcohol-free claim.

definition.en: Eggs gently baked in small individual dishes, often with cream and optional cheese or other additions.
definition.zh: 将鸡蛋打入小烤盅，常加入奶油，再以温和方式焗至凝固；许多做法会隔水烘烤。奶酪、火腿、菠菜等属于可变配料，cocotte 在这里强调盛装与烹调方式，不是固定的一套配方。

sources.title: Richard Bainbridge / Great British Chefs — Eggs en cocotte

examples.en: The eggs are baked in individual ramekins with cream and cheese, with toast served alongside.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋与奶油、奶酪放在独立小烤盅中焗制，旁边配烤面包。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
The source verifies a bain-marie preparation and optional ham or spinach; no universal doneness or dietary guarantee is inferred.

definition.en: A seasoned meat filling baked inside a pastry case, then cooled and sliced for serving.
definition.zh: 将调味肉馅包在面皮中烘烤，冷却后切片供应，是法式熟肉冷盘的经典品项。肉类可用猪肉、禽肉等组合，常有肉冻；en croûte 表示包裹在面皮中，不代表馅料只能用肝。

sources.title: Matt Ryle / Great British Chefs — Pâté en croûte

examples.en: This pâté is baked in pastry and served in slices; I can explain the meats in today’s filling.
examples.zh: 这款肉酱派在面皮中烘烤后切片供应；我可以为您介绍今天肉馅的组成。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
The recipe verifies a pork-based filling with foie gras and jelly; the general entry does not impose that exact filling on all versions.

definition.en: Pork slowly cooked until tender, shredded and mixed with its fat and juices to make a spread.
definition.zh: 猪肉经长时间缓慢烹调后撕成细丝，再与油脂和肉汁拌成可涂抹的熟肉酱，常配面包作为前菜。质地保留肉丝，与完全打细的肝酱不同；这里只收录猪肉版本。

sources.title: Emma Macdonald / Great British Chefs — Pork rillettes

examples.en: The pork rillettes have a soft, shredded texture and are served with crusty bread.
examples.zh: 这款猪肉酥酱口感柔软，并保留肉丝，搭配脆皮面包供应。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Generic rillettes is not an alias because duck, rabbit and fish versions also exist; no preservation or shelf-life instructions are given.

definition.en: A rustic meat terrine baked in a mould, chilled and served in slices, commonly based on pork.
definition.zh: 把调味肉馅装入长形模具烘烤，冷却定形后切片供应的乡村风格熟肉冷盘，常以猪肉为主。这里的“冻”指冷却定形的肉制品，不是甜味果冻；与包有面皮的 pâté en croûte 要区分。

sources.title: Grégory Marchand — Terrine de Campagne, published by Taste of France

examples.en: The country terrine is a chilled pork preparation served in slices with bread.
examples.zh: 这款乡村肉酱冻以猪肉制成，冷却后切片，搭配面包供应。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Chef recipe confirms pork, fat, bacon and mould/bain-marie cooking. Liver is not asserted as mandatory; source storage and temperature claims are not reproduced.

definition.en: A smooth chilled soup made with leeks and potatoes and enriched with cream or a similar dairy ingredient.
definition.zh: 以韭葱和土豆煮熟打细，再加入奶油或类似乳制品，冷却后供应的浓汤。学习重点是 chilled：它的冷食方式是菜品特色；汤底与乳制品可随餐厅配方改变。

examples.en: The vichyssoise is served chilled, with a smooth leek and potato base.
examples.zh: 这道维希冷汤以韭葱和土豆为基底，口感细滑，冷食供应。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
French cuisine is the menu-learning grouping; no claim about the dish’s contested historical birthplace is made. Hot leek-and-potato soup is not an alias.

definition.en: A smooth, concentrated lobster soup built from a shell-based stock, often finished with cream.
definition.zh: 先用龙虾壳与香味蔬菜熬出汤底，再过滤、调浓并常以奶油收尾的细滑浓汤。龙虾香气可以主要来自虾壳；是否另放龙虾肉、如何增稠，要以实际菜谱说明，不能只凭菜名保证。

sources.title: Gordon Ramsay Restaurants — Lobster and Cornish Crab Bisque

examples.en: The bisque gets its deep flavour from lobster shells and is finished with cream.
examples.zh: 这道浓汤以龙虾壳熬出浓郁风味，最后加入奶油。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Brown verifies a lobster-shell preparation without meat garnish; Ramsay’s mixed-shellfish version supports variation. Generic bisque is not an alias.

definition.en: Desalted salt cod worked with olive oil into a creamy preparation, with dairy or other additions depending on the recipe.
definition.zh: 把盐渍鳕鱼浸泡脱盐、煮熟后，与橄榄油搅拌成绵滑鱼泥；可加入蒜、奶油等调整风味和质地。它是熟鱼制品，不是生鱼泥，也不能仅因外观细白就当作普通土豆泥。

sources.title: Jeremy Lee / Great British Chefs — Brandade de morue

examples.en: The brandade is made from salt cod blended with olive oil; this version also contains cream.
examples.zh: 这道鱼泥由盐鳕鱼与橄榄油搅拌而成，这个版本也含奶油。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Entry stays within the verified salt-cod/olive-oil preparation; dairy is recipe-dependent and generic brandade is not used as an alias.

definition.en: Soft pike dumplings made from fish mixed with a cooked flour or semolina base, eggs and butter, then cooked and sauced.
definition.zh: 以淡水狗鱼（pike / brochet）肉混合熟面糊或粗粒小麦粉基底、鸡蛋和黄油，塑成柔软的椭圆鱼茸丸，常烤焗后配酱汁。里昂菜单上常见的 Nantua 酱以淡水螯虾风味为特色，但并非每一份都用同一种酱。

sources.title: FAO — Northern pike / Brochet du Nord / 白斑狗鱼

examples.en: These are delicate pike dumplings; our version is baked and served with a crayfish sauce.
examples.zh: 这是口感细嫩的狗鱼茸丸，我们的版本以烤焗方式烹调，配淡水螯虾酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
A producer recipe verifies semolina, egg, butter and pike, and tourism verifies Nantua service. Generic quenelle can mean other foods or a shape, so it is excluded as an alias.
Root review: corrected pike/brochet from 梭鱼 to 狗鱼 using FAO species terminology.

definition.en: Sole fillets with white grapes and a wine-based sauce, often enriched with cream.
definition.zh: 鳎鱼柳配含白葡萄的葡萄酒或味美思酱汁，常加入奶油，带有葡萄的清甜。具体鱼种、乳制品及香草配料会变化；Véronique 不能被解释成所有奶油鱼料理。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Lemon Sole Veronique
California Table Grape Commission — Sole Véronique

examples.en: The sole is served with white grapes in a creamy vermouth sauce.
examples.zh: 这道鳎鱼配白葡萄，淋上奶油味美思酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Chef and grape commission recipes verify grapes, sole and wine/vermouth; cream is common but not required in the definition. Fish species is not generalized to unrelated flatfish.

definition.en: Trout served with toasted almonds and butter, commonly pan-fried and finished with lemon.
definition.zh: 鳟鱼经煎制等方式烹调后，配烘香的杏仁片与黄油，常以柠檬平衡油润口感。英文菜单也常写 trout amandine 或 trout almondine；鱼可整条或鱼柳供应，服务时应说明实际呈现。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook trout
RICARDO — Trout with Brown Butter and Almonds

examples.en: The trout comes with toasted almonds and brown butter, with lemon on the side.
examples.zh: 这道鳟鱼配烘香杏仁片和焦化黄油，旁边附柠檬。

reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Cooking guide verifies the classic name, while the recipe verifies brown butter and almonds. Whole-fish and fillet service are not treated as an identical guarantee.

definition.en: A seared steak seasoned generously with peppercorns and served with a peppery pan sauce.
definition.zh: 牛排以胡椒粒调味，煎制后配胡椒锅汁；酱汁常用高汤、白兰地和少量奶油。Au poivre 强调胡椒，而非辣椒；牛肉部位、胡椒种类及是否加奶油，应按餐厅版本介绍。

sources.title: Bryan Webb / Great British Chefs — Steak au poivre

examples.en: The steak has a peppercorn crust and a rich pan sauce; how would you like it cooked?
examples.zh: 这款牛排表面带胡椒粒，配浓郁锅汁；您希望几分熟？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Avoids generic pepper steak as an alias because it can name unrelated dishes. Sauce dairy and alcohol are not assumed absent.

definition.en: Beef fillet served on toast with foie gras, a rich sauce and, in the classical presentation, truffle.
definition.zh: 把菲力牛排放在烤面包或煎面包上，搭配肥肝、浓郁肉汁，经典呈现还会加入松露。常见酱汁以马德拉酒调味；服务介绍要说明所用肥肝、松露及酱汁，不能只把它译成普通牛排。

sources.title: Richard Turner / Great British Chefs — Tournedos Rossini

examples.en: The fillet is topped with foie gras and served on toast with a Madeira sauce.
examples.zh: 菲力牛排上放肥肝，以面包垫底，搭配马德拉酒酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Core composition verified. Conflicting inventor stories are deliberately omitted; foie gras is not translated as exclusively goose liver.

definition.en: Chicken cooked with peppers, tomatoes, onion and garlic in a Basque-style sauce.
definition.zh: 鸡肉与彩椒、番茄、洋葱、蒜等一起烹煮的巴斯克风味料理，常加入埃斯佩莱特辣椒或其他香料。它的重点是蔬菜酱汁与鸡肉结合；辣度、配米饭或其他主食，需要按具体菜单确认。

sources.title: Stevan Paul / Taste France — Poulet Basquaise

examples.en: The chicken is cooked with tomatoes, sweet peppers and a little Espelette pepper.
examples.zh: 鸡肉与番茄、甜椒和少量埃斯佩莱特辣椒一起烹煮。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Classified with French menus without claiming Basque cuisine is exclusively French. Mildness is not guaranteed from the name.

definition.en: A slow-cooked lamb stew with vegetables such as turnips and carrots, often associated with spring menus.
definition.zh: 羊肉先煎上色，再与高汤和蔬菜缓慢炖煮，常见配菜包括芜菁、胡萝卜等，也常以春季蔬菜版本出现。羊肉炖得柔软是特点；酒、鱼类调味料或豆类等配方差异应向厨房核实。

sources.title: Richard Corrigan / Great British Chefs — Lamb navarin

examples.en: The lamb is slowly braised until tender and served with turnips and carrots.
examples.zh: 羊肉缓慢焖炖至软嫩，再与芜菁和胡萝卜一起供应。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Chef recipe contains anchovies, supporting the need to verify hidden ingredients. Disputed etymology is not asserted.

definition.en: Rabbit cooked until tender and served with a mustard sauce, often enriched with cream.
definition.zh: 兔肉先煎上色，再用酒、高汤等炖煮，配以芥末为主调、常含奶油的酱汁。有些版本另加培根；moutarde 是芥末调味，不等同于辣椒辣味，也不能据菜名判断是否只含兔肉。

sources.title: Chef Alex Jackson / Taste France — Lapin à la Moutarde

examples.en: The rabbit is braised and finished with a creamy mustard sauce; this version includes bacon.
examples.zh: 兔肉经焖炖后配奶油芥末酱汁，这个版本也加入培根。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Mustard, cream and bacon verified in the chef’s recipe; the general entry allows other versions.

definition.en: Duck served with a sweet-sharp orange sauce, traditionally presented as a roast duck dish.
definition.zh: 烤鸭或烹熟的鸭肉配兼具甜味与酸味的橙汁酱，酱汁可含高汤、橙皮、焦糖和酒类。这里的 orange 指橙子风味，不表示酱汁只是鲜榨果汁；整鸭与鸭胸等版本应按菜单说明。

sources.title: Le Cordon Bleu — Duck à l’orange, published on ckbk

examples.en: The roast duck is served with an orange sauce that balances sweetness and acidity.
examples.zh: 烤鸭搭配橙汁酱，酱汁兼具甜味与酸味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Chef source verifies orange, stock, caramel and liqueur; historical origin claims and an alcohol-free claim are excluded.

definition.en: Hollowed tomatoes filled with a savoury stuffing and baked; meat-based fillings are common.
definition.zh: 将番茄掏出部分果肉，填入调味馅料后烘烤，常用小牛肉、牛肉或猪肉，配香草、面包屑等。菜名只说明“酿番茄”，并不保证馅料是素食；服务时应补充具体肉类和配菜。

sources.title: Stephen Cooks French / Taste of France — Tomates farcies

examples.en: These baked tomatoes are filled with veal, herbs and breadcrumbs and served with rice.
examples.zh: 这些烤番茄填入小牛肉、香草和面包屑，搭配米饭供应。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Exact primary recipe verifies veal with beef/pork substitutions, breadcrumbs and rice; a broad worldwide stuffed-tomato alias is excluded.

definition.en: Beef slowly braised with wine, aromatics and vegetables until tender, with ingredients varying by region and cook.
definition.zh: 适合慢炖的牛肉与葡萄酒、香味蔬菜等长时间焖煮，常呈现浓郁肉汁与软嫩质地。有些配方加入橙、香草或腌肉；daube 是一类炖法与菜品，不能直接当成勃艮第炖牛肉的别名。

sources.title: Eric Chavot / Great British Chefs — Daube de boeuf

examples.en: Our beef daube is slowly braised in red wine with vegetables and a touch of orange.
examples.zh: 我们的炖牛肉以红酒、蔬菜和少许橙慢慢焖煮。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
The specific beef entry is distinct from broad daube and from boeuf bourguignon. Orange in the service example is directly supported by the linked recipe.

definition.en: Cooked white chicory wrapped in ham, covered with a white or cheese sauce and browned on top.
definition.zh: 将煮软或焖软的白菊苣包入火腿，淋白酱或奶酪白酱，再烤至表面金黄。白菊苣带轻微苦味，火腿与乳酪带咸鲜；该菜也常见于比利时，分类不代表专属起源。

sources.title: Chef Henry Harris / Nigella guest recipes — Endive Au Gratin
Bruno Albouze — Endives With Ham Gratin

examples.en: The chicory is wrapped in ham, covered with cheese sauce and browned under the grill.
examples.zh: 白菊苣用火腿包裹，淋上奶酪酱，再烤至表面金黄。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
British chicory and US endive naming clarified through the bilingual-ingredient chef recipe; generic endive gratin can omit ham and is not an alias.

definition.en: A leaf salad topped with warm goat’s cheese, often served on toasted bread with a vinaigrette.
definition.zh: 将温热的山羊奶酪与生菜组合，奶酪常放在烤面包上，配油醋类沙拉汁。核桃、蜂蜜、培根或水果都可能成为配料；chaud 指温热的奶酪部分，并非整盘蔬菜都煮热。

sources.title: Taste France — Warm Goat’s Cheese Salad

examples.en: The salad is topped with warm goat’s cheese on toast; this version also has walnuts.
examples.zh: 沙拉上放着铺有温热山羊奶酪的烤面包，这个版本也含核桃。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Optional nuts, bacon and honey are distinguished from the core dish; no vegetarian or allergen guarantee is made.

definition.en: Thin potato slices layered with butter and cooked into a cake with browned edges and a tender centre.
definition.zh: 把土豆薄片与黄油层层叠放，煎烤成有层次的圆饼或块状配菜，边缘焦香、内部柔软。这里的 pommes 指 pommes de terre（土豆），不是苹果；与奶油焗土豆并非同一道菜。

sources.title: Institute of Culinary Education — Pommes Anna

examples.en: The pommes Anna are layered potatoes cooked with butter until crisp around the edges.
examples.zh: 安娜土豆饼把土豆与黄油层层叠放，烹调至边缘酥脆。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Culinary school recipe verifies overlapping potato layers and clarified butter. No origin story or compulsory cream ingredient is added.

definition.en: Small savoury choux-pastry puffs with grated cheese mixed into the dough.
definition.zh: 在泡芙面糊中加入磨碎奶酪，烤成蓬松的咸味小点，常作为开胃小食。它与夹奶油的甜泡芙不同；奶酪种类会变，且常见版本本身没有夹馅。

sources.title: Simon Hulstone / Great British Chefs — Gougères
Galton Blackiston / Great British Chefs — Gruyère gougères

examples.en: The gougères are warm, savoury cheese puffs with a light, airy centre.
examples.zh: 这些奶酪泡芙温热供应，带咸香奶酪味，内部轻盈蓬松。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Multiple recipes support variation in cheese. Generic cheese puff could refer to unrelated snacks, so it is excluded as a stand-alone alias.

definition.en: Cherries baked in a soft, egg-rich batter, giving a texture between a pudding and a cake.
definition.zh: 把樱桃放入富含鸡蛋的面糊中烘烤，成品质地介于布丁与蛋糕之间，通常没有独立派皮。奶、奶油及杏仁等配方会变化；本词条限定樱桃版，服务时也应确认樱桃是否去核。

sources.title: Pascal Aussignac / Great British Chefs — Griotte cherry clafoutis

examples.en: The cherry clafoutis is baked in a soft batter and has a tender, custard-like texture.
examples.zh: 樱桃烘蛋糕以柔软面糊烤成，口感细嫩，带有类似蛋奶布丁的质地。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Specific cherry version; generic clafoutis is not an alias because menus use other fruit versions. The linked chef recipe uses pitted cherries but this is not generalized.

definition.en: A chilled chocolate dessert with an airy texture created by folding in whipped egg whites or cream.
definition.zh: 将巧克力与打发蛋白或奶油等结合，冷却后形成轻盈蓬松的甜点。Mousse 指充气后的细软质地，不是固态巧克力蛋糕；不同做法的蛋、乳制品组成不同，应按配方说明。

sources.title: Alain Ducasse / Académie du Goût — Mousse au chocolat
Great British Chefs — How to make chocolate mousse

examples.en: The chocolate mousse has an airy texture and an intense dark-chocolate flavour.
examples.zh: 这款巧克力慕斯质地轻盈，黑巧克力风味浓郁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Ducasse verifies whipped egg whites, dark chocolate and butter; the culinary guide verifies cream-based variations. No claim that every mousse uses cooked eggs.

definition.en: A ring-shaped choux pastry filled with praline-flavoured cream, often finished with almonds.
definition.zh: 经典形态为环状泡芙，切开后夹入带焦糖坚果风味的 praline 奶油，常以杏仁装饰。它不是面包圈；坚果种类和奶油组成可因配方变化，介绍时应说清具体馅料。

sources.title: Merlin Labron-Johnson / Great British Chefs — Classic Paris-Brest
Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Paris-Brest

examples.en: The Paris-Brest is a choux pastry ring filled with praline cream.
examples.zh: 巴黎布雷斯特是环状泡芙，内夹焦糖坚果奶油。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Classic form and praline cream verified; modern individual shapes are not excluded. No unsupported nut-free variants are described.

definition.en: A layered pastry dessert combining crisp puff pastry with cream or pastry cream, sometimes with fruit.
definition.zh: 把烤脆的起酥面皮与奶油或卡仕达类馅料交叠组合，形成酥脆与柔滑对比的甜点。有些版本加水果；mille-feuille 的“千层”是形容层次，并非要求实际有一千层，也不同于薄煎饼千层蛋糕。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to make mille-feuille

examples.en: The mille-feuille has crisp pastry layers with a light cream filling.
examples.zh: 这款千层酥由酥脆面皮层夹着轻盈奶油馅组成。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Only the dessert sense is covered. Generic layered dishes, mille-crêpes and savoury variants are not silently mapped to this entry.

definition.en: A pastry tart filled with a smooth, tangy lemon mixture, commonly set with eggs.
definition.zh: 酥脆塔皮中填入带酸甜平衡的细滑柠檬馅，常以鸡蛋帮助凝固。奶油、黄油和塔皮坚果成分会随做法变化；菜名不必然表示表面有蛋白霜，需要与 lemon meringue tart 区分。

examples.en: The lemon tart has a crisp pastry base and a smooth, tangy filling.
examples.zh: 柠檬塔以酥脆塔皮为底，内馅细滑，带清晰酸味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Producer’s recipe verifies eggs, lemon, cream and a pastry base with almonds. Meringue is not assumed, and generic lemon desserts are not aliases.

definition.en: Small French cakes made with ground almonds, egg whites and browned butter, traditionally baked in rectangular moulds.
definition.zh: 以杏仁粉、蛋白和焦化黄油为主要特色的小蛋糕，质地湿润，常带坚果与黄油香。传统长方形像小金条，但也有圆形及水果版本；不要因为颜色或形状相近就把它当作玛德琳。

examples.en: The financiers are small almond cakes with a nutty flavour from browned butter.
examples.zh: 费南雪是杏仁小蛋糕，焦化黄油带来类似坚果的香气。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: 2026-10-26 editorial review against the linked recipes; definitions and bilingual teaching examples are original.
Author’s recipe directly verifies almonds, egg whites, flour and browned butter; financial-job meaning of financier is avoided in aliases.

definition.en: Flaked salt cod combined with fine fried potato strips, onions and softly set eggs.
definition.zh: 将浸泡脱盐的盐渍鳕鱼拆散，与洋葱、炸细薯丝及鸡蛋拌炒；鸡蛋将食材裹合成柔软口感。菜单常保留葡语名称，不能仅译成烤鳕鱼。

sources.title: Chef José Avillez / RTP — Bacalhau à Brás

examples.en: Bacalhau à Brás combines flaked salt cod, crisp potato strips and soft eggs.
examples.zh: 这道葡式鳕鱼薯丝炒蛋把鳕鱼碎、酥脆细薯丝与柔软鸡蛋结合在一起。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Source is a chef variation with olive spheres; the explanation retains the verified core preparation and does not treat the modern garnish as universal.
Original teaching explanation and illustrative service example; restaurant recipes and accompaniments can vary.

entries.zh: 戈梅斯式鳕鱼土豆烤盘

definition.en: A Portuguese baked dish of salt cod, sliced potatoes and onions, commonly finished with boiled eggs and olives.
definition.zh: 脱盐鳕鱼与土豆片、炒软的洋葱组合后入炉，常配水煮蛋片、橄榄及欧芹。与 à Brás 的薯丝炒蛋不同，这道菜以较完整的土豆片和分层烤制见长。

sources.title: Chef Luís Machado / RTP — Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá

examples.en: The cod is baked with sliced potatoes and onions, then finished with egg and olives.
examples.zh: 鳕鱼与土豆片、洋葱一同烤制，再配上鸡蛋和橄榄。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Differentiated from Bacalhau à Brás; egg here is boiled rather than scrambled into the dish.
Original teaching explanation and illustrative service example; restaurant recipes and accompaniments can vary.

definition.en: A potato-based soup with finely shredded leafy greens, often served with sliced Portuguese sausage.
definition.zh: 以土豆、洋葱和蒜煮出柔滑汤底，再加入切得很细的甘蓝类叶菜。常配 chouriço 等葡式香肠和玉米面包；名字虽含“绿色”，并不代表一定是素汤。

sources.title: Visit Portugal / Lisbon Tourism and Hospitality School — Caldo-Verde

examples.en: Our caldo verde has a smooth potato base with finely shredded greens and slices of sausage.
examples.zh: 我们的葡式甘蓝汤以柔滑土豆汤为底，加入细切叶菜和香肠片。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Leafy-green translations vary; use 甘蓝类叶菜 rather than assuming all recipes use curly kale. Source includes meat sausage.
Original teaching explanation and illustrative service example; restaurant recipes and accompaniments can vary.

definition.en: Fish and shellfish cooked with vegetables in a covered cataplana pan.
definition.zh: 将鱼块、蛤蜊、虾与洋葱、番茄、甜椒等放入带盖的 cataplana 锅中焖煮。Cataplana 同时指锅具和这类菜；这里特指鱼贝海鲜版本，配料随菜单变化。

sources.title: Visit Portugal / Lisbon Tourism and Hospitality School — Cataplana de Peixe

examples.en: This cataplana brings fish, clams and prawns together in a fragrant vegetable broth.
examples.zh: 这道葡式海鲜锅把鱼、蛤蜊和虾焖在带有蔬菜香气的汤汁中。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Source recipe includes fish, clams and prawns. Do not map the broader vessel name cataplana to this one seafood preparation.
Original teaching explanation and illustrative service example; restaurant recipes and accompaniments can vary.

definition.en: Portuguese rice cooked with seafood and stock, often served loose and brothy.
definition.zh: 米饭吸收海鲜与高汤的味道，常保留较湿润的汤汁；可用虾、蛤蜊、鱿鱼或其他当日海鲜。与干爽型炒饭不同，海鲜组合和稠度应按本店做法介绍。

sources.title: Chef Telmo Faria / Williams Sonoma — Arroz de Marisco

examples.en: The seafood rice is served slightly brothy, with prawns, clams and squid.
examples.zh: 这道海鲜饭保留少量汤汁，配有虾、蛤蜊和鱿鱼。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Chef source explicitly describes a loose rice mixture. Avoid equating the Portuguese dish with Italian risotto.
Original teaching explanation and illustrative service example; restaurant recipes and accompaniments can vary.

definition.en: Rice cooked in duck stock, layered with shredded duck and commonly browned in the oven with sausage.
definition.zh: 先煮鸭取肉及汤，再以鸭汤煮饭，和鸭肉丝组合后入炉烤香。常见表面配 chouriço 或培根，因此不宜只按名称推断全部肉类成分。

sources.title: Chef Paulo Matias / Procatering — Arroz de Pato
Chef José Maria Lino / RTP — Arroz de pato

examples.en: The rice is cooked in duck stock and baked with shredded duck and slices of chouriço.
examples.zh: 米饭用鸭汤煮制，再与鸭肉丝和葡式香肠片一同烤香。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Both chef recipes verify stock and layering; Procatering verifies the oven finish. Do not imply the dish contains only duck.
Original teaching explanation and illustrative service example; restaurant recipes and accompaniments can vary.

definition.en: Tender cooked octopus finished in the oven with garlic, olive oil and potatoes.
definition.zh: 章鱼先煮至柔软，再与蒜、充足橄榄油及土豆入炉。常配轻压裂的带皮小土豆 batatas a murro；这里是章鱼菜，à lagareiro 这种做法也可用于鳕鱼。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to Make Cullen Skink

examples.zh: 卡伦熏鱼汤是一道温热的烟熏黑线鳕浓汤，里面有土豆和洋葱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

definition.en: Toast topped with a seasoned cheese mixture and grilled until browned.

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Toad in the Hole

examples.zh: 这道英式香肠烤布丁是在香肠周围烤出蓬松面糊层。

entries.zh: 伊顿草莓蛋白霜奶油甜点

definition.en: A dessert combining fruit, broken meringue and whipped cream.

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Weathering the Summer with Eton Mess

examples.en: Our Eton mess brings together strawberries, whipped cream and crisp pieces of meringue.
examples.zh: 我们的伊顿甜点把草莓、打发奶油和酥脆蛋白霜碎组合在一起。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Galton Blackiston’s Sticky Toffee Pudding

examples.zh: 太妃糖布丁是温热的椰枣海绵蛋糕，配浓郁太妃糖酱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Date sponge and butter-sugar-cream sauce checked; accompaniments vary.

definition.en: Buttered bread baked in an egg-and-milk custard, often with dried fruit.

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Bread and Butter Pudding
Great British Chefs — Bread and Butter Pudding Recipes

examples.en: The bread and butter pudding has soft custard-soaked bread and a golden top.
examples.zh: 黄油面包布丁内部是吸收蛋奶液的柔软面包，表面烤至金黄。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

definition.en: Poached eggs on English muffins with ham or bacon and hollandaise sauce.

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Eggs Florentine: Benedict and Royale Variants

examples.en: Our eggs Benedict come on English muffins with ham, poached eggs and hollandaise.
examples.zh: 我们的班尼迪克蛋配英式松饼、火腿、水波蛋和荷兰酱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

sources.title: Chef Billy Parisi — Traditional Cobb Salad

examples.en: The Cobb salad includes chicken, bacon, egg and avocado, with blue cheese for extra flavour.
examples.zh: 科布沙拉里有鸡肉、培根、鸡蛋和牛油果，并用蓝纹奶酪增添风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

definition.en: An apple-and-celery salad with a creamy dressing, often including walnuts and grapes.

sources.title: Hilton — Cooking with Chris: Waldorf Salad

examples.en: Our Waldorf salad combines crisp apple and celery with walnuts in a creamy dressing.
examples.zh: 我们的华尔道夫沙拉把爽脆苹果、西芹和核桃拌入柔滑酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Hilton’s history explicitly separates original apple/celery/mayonnaise from later walnut additions.

entries.zh: 新英格兰奶油蛤蜊浓汤

definition.en: A creamy clam soup with potatoes and onions, often flavoured with bacon or salt pork.
definition.zh: 蛤蜊与土豆、洋葱煮成的乳白色浓汤，通常加入牛奶或奶油，部分配方用培根或咸猪肉增香。New England 指此菜的风格，不能把所有 clam chowder 都直接解释成奶油版本。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — New England Clam Chowder

examples.en: The New England clam chowder is creamy, with clams, potatoes and a little bacon.
examples.zh: 新英格兰蛤蜊浓汤口感柔滑，里面有蛤蜊、土豆和少量培根。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Broader clam chowder is not used as an alias; cited preparation includes bacon and dairy.

definition.en: A split bread roll filled with chilled lobster meat dressed with mayonnaise.
definition.zh: 以切开的长面包夹冷龙虾肉沙拉，龙虾常拌蛋黄酱，可加西芹和柠檬；面包本身可以抹黄油烤暖。本词条特指冷龙虾沙拉版本，不把所有 lobster roll 都视作相同做法。

examples.en: Our Maine lobster roll has chilled lobster salad inside a warm, buttered roll.
examples.zh: 我们的缅因式龙虾包是在温热黄油面包里夹入冷龙虾沙拉。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Specific Maine-style cold filling; generic lobster roll deliberately excluded from aliases.

definition.en: Seasoned crab meat shaped into cakes with a small amount of binder and cooked until golden.
definition.zh: 以蟹肉块为主，加入适量面包糠、鸡蛋或蛋黄酱等帮助定形，调味后制成饼。不同餐厅会煎、炸或烤制；crab cake 是咸味蟹肉菜，不是甜蛋糕。

sources.title: Visit Maryland — Real Maryland Crab Cakes
Phillips Seafood — Shirley’s Original Crab Cakes

examples.en: The Maryland crab cakes have a golden exterior and a tender crab-meat centre.
examples.zh: 马里兰蟹肉饼外层金黄，中心是柔嫩蟹肉。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Regional style retained in term; generic crab cake not used as an exact alias. No universal claim about filler quantity or cooking method.

definition.en: Cooked macaroni coated in cheese sauce, sometimes baked with a crisp topping.
definition.zh: 短管状意面拌入奶酪酱，可直接上桌，也可铺面包糠再焗烤。美式菜单常简称 mac and cheese；奶酪种类、是否加肉以及是否烤制要看餐厅版本。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — Macaroni and Cheese

examples.en: Our macaroni and cheese is baked with a crisp breadcrumb topping.
examples.zh: 我们的奶酪通心粉铺面包糠焗烤，表面酥脆。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Definition allows stovetop and baked versions; example intentionally describes the cited baked style.

definition.en: Chicken wings coated in a tangy hot-sauce-and-butter mixture.
definition.zh: 鸡翅烹熟后裹上辣椒酱与黄油调成的酸辣酱汁，常配西芹和蓝纹奶酪蘸酱。Buffalo 在此是美国城市名称，不表示水牛肉；辣度与炸烤方式可因餐厅而异。

examples.en: The Buffalo wings are tangy and spicy, with a blue-cheese dip on the side.
examples.zh: 水牛城鸡翅带酸辣风味，旁边配蓝纹奶酪蘸酱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Avoids disputed invention attribution; sauce identity verified.

definition.en: A tart lime-and-condensed-milk pie, commonly made with egg yolks and a crumb crust.
definition.zh: 以青柠汁、炼乳和蛋黄做成酸甜顺滑内馅，常用饼干碎派底。传统名称指 Key lime 风味，但实际可能用其他青柠汁；奶油或蛋白霜装饰取决于配方。

sources.title: King Arthur Baking — Classic Key Lime Pie

examples.en: The Key lime pie has a bright citrus filling on a crisp crumb base.
examples.zh: 青柠派有清鲜酸甜的柑橘内馅，底部是酥脆饼干碎派底。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

definition.en: A baked cream-cheese cake with a dense, smooth filling, usually on a crust.
definition.zh: 用奶油奶酪和鸡蛋烤制的浓厚型芝士蛋糕，质地细密顺滑，部分配方加入酸奶油和柠檬。饼底及水果浇头会变化，与免烤或轻盈舒芙蕾型芝士蛋糕口感不同。

examples.en: The New York cheesecake is rich and smooth, with a slight tang from the filling.
examples.zh: 纽约芝士蛋糕口感浓厚顺滑，内馅带一点清爽酸味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

definition.en: Grated potatoes pan-fried into a flat cake with a crisp surface.
definition.zh: 将粗擦的土豆丝压成扁圆饼，用黄油或其他油脂煎出脆面。可用生土豆或预煮土豆，既能作配菜，也能加蛋、奶酪或肉类成为主菜。

sources.title: Switzerland Tourism — This Is Swiss Cuisine
Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Switzerland’s National Dishes

examples.zh: 这份瑞士土豆丝饼表面酥脆，在这道菜里配小牛肉上桌。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

definition.en: A pot of warm melted cheese into which diners dip pieces of bread.

sources.title: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Switzerland’s National Dishes

examples.en: The cheese fondue comes in a shared pot with bread for dipping.
examples.zh: 奶酪火锅以共享锅上桌，配面包块蘸食。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26

definition.en: Melted cheese served over potatoes with pickled accompaniments.
definition.zh: 菜单中可指把融化奶酪刮下或从小烤盘倒在土豆上，配酸黄瓜、腌洋葱等的菜肴。Raclette 也可指所用奶酪；本词条解释上桌的融奶酪餐，而非奶酪产区或等级。

sources.title: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Switzerland’s National Dishes

examples.en: The raclette is served with potatoes, gherkins and pickled onions.
examples.zh: 拉克莱特融奶酪餐配土豆、酸黄瓜和腌洋葱。

sources.title: Switzerland Tourism — This Is Swiss Cuisine

examples.en: The Zurich-style veal is served in a creamy mushroom sauce with rösti.
examples.zh: 苏黎世风味小牛肉配奶油蘑菇酱和瑞士土豆丝饼。

sources.title: Visit Sweden — Cured Salmon: Gravad Lax

definition.en: Grated potato mixed into pancake batter and pan-fried, often served with pork and lingonberries.

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 200+ dishes · 2026-10-26
reviewNotes: Generic potato pancake is not an alias; recipe contains a flour-milk-egg batter.

definition.en: Open-faced sandwiches, usually on rye bread, with carefully arranged savoury toppings.

sources.title: Trine Hahnemann — Smørrebrød: The Danish Lunch

definition.en: Spaghetti dressed in a dark cuttlefish-ink sauce, often with pieces of cuttlefish, garlic, parsley and white wine.
definition.zh: 以墨鱼汁制作深黑色酱汁的长意面，常加入墨鱼肉、蒜、欧芹和白葡萄酒，突出海鲜的咸鲜味。菜单中的这个名称通常描述整道墨鱼汁意面；它也可能被用来指面团本身染黑的干面，需要结合菜品说明理解。

sources.title: Chef Stefano Barbato — Spaghetti al nero di seppia

examples.en: The dark sauce gets its colour from cuttlefish ink, and we add pieces of cuttlefish.
examples.zh: 酱汁的黑色来自墨鱼汁，我们还加入了墨鱼肉。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27

Kept distinct from squid-ink-coloured pasta as an uncooked ingredient; this entry describes the prepared cuttlefish-ink dish.

definition.en: Linguine served with clawed lobster in a seafood sauce, commonly made with tomatoes, garlic, white wine and parsley.
definition.zh: 扁长面配螯龙虾，常以小番茄、蒜、白葡萄酒和欧芹煮成海鲜酱汁，再将面条与酱汁拌匀。Astice 指有大螯的龙虾，与意大利语 aragosta 所指的无螯刺龙虾有别。

sources.title: Chef Michele Ghedini / Cookist — Linguine all’astice

examples.en: The lobster linguine has a light tomato sauce with garlic and parsley.
examples.zh: 这道龙虾扁意面配清爽的番茄酱汁，并加入蒜和欧芹。

entries.zh: 番茄蒜香玛丽娜拉披萨

definition.en: A pizza topped with tomato, garlic, oregano and olive oil, with a simple, fragrant topping.
definition.zh: 以番茄、蒜、牛至和橄榄油为主要配料的披萨。经典做法不放奶酪或海鲜，因此介绍 marinara 时可直接说清番茄与蒜香的组合，避免客人把名称理解成海鲜披萨。

examples.en: The marinara is topped with tomato, garlic, oregano and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这款玛丽娜拉披萨的配料是番茄、蒜、牛至和橄榄油。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
Do not alias the dish to marinara alone, which can also name a sauce.

definition.en: A pizza topped with four cheeses, combining different melting qualities and flavours; the cheese selection depends on the recipe.
definition.zh: Quattro formaggi 意为四种奶酪，指以四款奶酪组合成配料的披萨。常见选择包括马苏里拉、戈贡佐拉、普罗沃洛内及塔莱吉奥；不同餐厅可更换组合，介绍时列出本店实际使用的奶酪最有帮助。

sources.title: Gozney / Feng Chen — Pizza quattro formaggi

examples.en: Our four-cheese pizza includes Gorgonzola, which adds a distinctive blue-cheese flavour.
examples.zh: 我们的四种奶酪披萨包含戈贡佐拉，带有明显的蓝纹奶酪风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
Do not alias quattro formaggi alone: the same phrase is also used for pasta sauces.

definition.en: Italian meatballs finished in tomato sauce, with a meat mixture that may include softened bread, egg, herbs and grated cheese.
definition.zh: 将调味肉馅拌入泡软的面包、鸡蛋、香草或磨碎的奶酪，做成肉丸，再与番茄酱汁一起烹煮。肉馅可以是猪肉或其他组合；上菜时重点介绍柔嫩的肉丸与番茄酱，而不是默认它一定配意面。

sources.title: Chef Antonia Klugmann / La Cucina Italiana — Polpette al sugo e fritte

examples.en: These pork meatballs are gently cooked in tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 这些猪肉丸用番茄酱汁慢慢煮至入味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
The cited chef recipe uses pork; the general definition preserves variation in meat blends.

entries.zh: 罗马式番茄薄荷炖牛肚

definition.en: Beef tripe cooked in tomato sauce with aromatic vegetables, mint and grated Pecorino Romano.
definition.zh: 将处理好的牛肚与番茄、洋葱、芹菜等慢煮，最后用薄荷与佩科里诺罗马羊奶酪增香。牛肚是牛的胃部，煮好后柔软而保留弹性；薄荷的清香是介绍这道罗马菜时很有辨识度的细节。

examples.en: The tripe is slow-cooked with tomato, then finished with mint and Pecorino Romano.
examples.zh: 牛肚与番茄慢煮，最后加入薄荷和佩科里诺罗马羊奶酪。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: Beef slowly braised with Barolo wine and aromatic vegetables, then sliced and served with its rich cooking sauce.
definition.zh: 把牛肉与巴罗洛红葡萄酒及芳香蔬菜慢慢焖至软嫩，切片后淋上浓郁的烹调酱汁，常配玉米糊等吸收酱汁的主食。Brasato 提示的是焖煮方式，Barolo 则是这道菜使用的烹调酒。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Brasato al Barolo

examples.en: The beef is braised in Barolo wine and served with creamy polenta.
examples.zh: 牛肉用巴罗洛红酒焖制，配柔滑的玉米糊。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: A cooked beef steak sliced before serving, often presented with rocket and shavings of Parmigiano Reggiano.
definition.zh: 将煎制或烤制好的牛排切片上桌，常搭配芝麻菜、帕尔马奶酪薄片和橄榄油。Tagliata 强调切片呈现，并不指定唯一的牛肉部位；服务时可进一步说明本店部位和建议熟度。

examples.en: We serve the tagliata sliced, with rocket and Parmesan shavings.
examples.zh: 我们的牛排切片后上桌，搭配芝麻菜和帕尔马奶酪薄片。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: An assortment of meats gently simmered until tender, sliced and served with condiments such as salsa verde or mostarda.
definition.zh: 将不同部位或种类的肉以小火清煮至软嫩，再切片组合上桌。可包含牛肉、牛舌、禽肉或意式猪肉肠，搭配意式香草绿酱或芥末水果酱；misto 表示混合拼盘。

sources.title: Chef Leonardo De Paoli / La Cucina Italiana — Bollito misto

examples.en: The bollito misto is a selection of gently simmered meats, with the sauces served alongside.
examples.zh: 这道清煮肉类拼盘包含几种慢煮肉类，酱料另外奉上。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: A tall, domed Italian festive sweet bread made from enriched, slowly fermented dough, traditionally studded with raisins and candied citrus peel.
definition.zh: 高耸圆顶状的意式节庆甜面包，以加入黄油和蛋黄的面团经较长时间发酵制成，组织轻盈而有拉丝感。经典版本加入葡萄干和糖渍柑橘皮，切片后可作早餐、茶点或甜点。

sources.title: Andrea Tortora / Great Italian Chefs — Panettone

examples.en: Would you like a slice of panettone with your coffee? It contains raisins and candied orange peel.
examples.zh: 您想配咖啡来一片潘妮托妮吗？里面有葡萄干和糖渍橙皮。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: A tall, star-shaped Italian sweet bread with a soft, buttery crumb, usually dusted with icing sugar.
definition.zh: 用富含黄油与鸡蛋的发酵面团烤成高耸的星形甜面包，表面常撒糖粉，内部柔软、色泽金黄并带香草气息。经典潘多洛以面包本身的黄油香为主，与常含葡萄干及糖渍果皮的潘妮托妮形成鲜明区别。

examples.en: Pandoro is our soft, buttery sweet bread, served with a light dusting of icing sugar.
examples.zh: 潘多洛是一款柔软、黄油香浓的甜面包，上桌前会薄薄撒上糖粉。

entries.zh: 卡普里巧克力杏仁蛋糕

definition.en: A rich chocolate-and-almond cake with a tender, moist centre; some recipes also include other ground nuts or a little starch.
definition.zh: 以巧克力、磨碎的杏仁、黄油、糖和鸡蛋制成的浓郁蛋糕，中心湿润，表层较薄。部分做法加入榛子或少量淀粉；这里的 Caprese 指这款甜点，与番茄、马苏里拉奶酪组成的卡普雷塞沙拉是不同菜品。

sources.title: Sal De Riso / GialloZafferano — Torta caprese

examples.en: The torta Caprese is a moist chocolate cake made with ground almonds.
examples.zh: 卡普里蛋糕是一款加入杏仁粉、口感湿润的巧克力蛋糕。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
No blanket gluten-free or nut-free claim; the cited Sal De Riso version also contains hazelnuts and potato starch.

definition.en: A rustic chestnut-flour cake made with water and olive oil, commonly topped with rosemary, pine nuts, raisins and sometimes walnuts.
definition.zh: 将栗子粉与水、橄榄油调成面糊烘烤，再以迷迭香、松子、葡萄干或核桃增添风味。它呈现栗子的自然甜味与香草气息，是质地较扎实的栗粉烤糕，适合用 chestnut-flour cake 向客人解释。

examples.en: The castagnaccio is made with chestnut flour and has rosemary, pine nuts and raisins.
examples.zh: 这款栗粉烤糕用栗子粉制作，带有迷迭香、松子和葡萄干。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27

entries.zh: 煎蛋火腿奶酪烤三明治

definition.en: A hot ham-and-cheese sandwich topped with a fried egg, often enriched with béchamel and browned under the grill.
definition.zh: 在热火腿奶酪三明治上加一枚煎蛋，常搭配贝夏梅尔白酱，再把表面奶酪烤至金黄。与 croque-monsieur 相比，煎蛋是最容易向客人说明的区别，常作为早午餐或简餐。

sources.title: Great British Chefs / Nancy Anne Harbord — Croque madame

examples.en: The croque-madame is a toasted ham-and-cheese sandwich with béchamel and a fried egg on top.
examples.zh: 这道煎蛋火腿奶酪烤三明治配贝夏梅尔白酱，顶部加一枚煎蛋。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: Hard-boiled eggs, usually halved, topped with mayonnaise and served as a simple cold starter.
definition.zh: 将煮熟、去壳的鸡蛋切半，表面淋上或挤上蛋黄酱，作为冷前菜上桌。蛋黄酱常以蛋黄、芥末和油乳化制成；这道菜的重点是完整蛋块与顺滑酱汁的搭配。

examples.en: Our eggs mayonnaise starter is served cold, with halved boiled eggs and mustard mayonnaise.
examples.zh: 我们的蛋黄酱水煮蛋前菜是冷盘，用切半的水煮蛋搭配芥末蛋黄酱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: Salmon enclosed in pastry and baked, often with a filling of greens, herbs or a creamy cheese mixture.
definition.zh: 将三文鱼包入酥皮烘烤，外层金黄酥脆，内层可加入菠菜、西洋菜、香草或奶酪馅。En croûte 在这里表示包在面皮中烤制，说明的是做法；夹层配料可随餐厅版本变化。

sources.title: Mercotte — Saumon en croûte à la julienne de légumes

examples.en: The salmon is baked in puff pastry with spinach and cream cheese.
examples.zh: 三文鱼与菠菜、奶油奶酪一起包入酥皮烘烤。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27

definition.en: Scallops coated in a creamy sauce, often with mushrooms, then briefly browned in shells or small baking dishes.
definition.zh: 扇贝配奶油酱汁与蘑菇，放在贝壳或小烤皿中焗至表面上色。有的版本以土豆泥围边；gratinées 提示上层烤出金黄色泽，介绍时可同时说明扇贝的嫩度与酱汁的浓润口感。

sources.title: Chef Michel Dumas — Coquilles Saint-Jacques gratinées

examples.en: The scallops are baked with mushrooms in a creamy sauce until the top is golden.
examples.zh: 扇贝与蘑菇、奶油酱汁一起焗烤，表面呈金黄色。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
