definition.en: A slow-cooked beef dish with generous carrots, onions, herbs and stock, often with wine in the braising liquid.
definition.zh: 以适合慢煮的牛肉部位，搭配较多胡萝卜、洋葱、香草及高汤，焖至肉质软嫩、胡萝卜甜味融入酱汁。不同厨师可用白葡萄酒或红葡萄酒烹调，菜名重点在牛肉与胡萝卜的组合。

sources.title: Alain Ducasse / Académie du Goût — Bœuf aux carottes

examples.en: The beef is slowly braised with carrots and herbs until tender.
examples.zh: 牛肉与胡萝卜、香草一起慢焖至软嫩。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: An individual puff-pastry case filled with a creamy savoury mixture, often featuring poultry, mushrooms or veal sweetbreads.
definition.zh: 一人份的圆形酥皮盅，装入奶油风味的咸馅，常见配料有鸡肉、蘑菇或小牛胸腺，顶部可盖回小酥皮盖。酱汁常以禽类高汤和油面糊为基础，再加入奶油；点餐时应说明本店实际馅料。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Bouchées à la reine

examples.en: Our bouchée à la reine is a puff-pastry case filled with chicken and mushrooms in a creamy sauce.
examples.zh: 我们的酥皮盅装入鸡肉和蘑菇，配浓滑的奶油酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
Do not use vol-au-vent alone as an exact alias: the pastry format admits many different fillings. Sweetbread is organ meat, not bread.

entries.en: cuisses de grenouilles à la persillade
aliases: frogs’ legs with garlic and parsley
frogs' legs with garlic and parsley

definition.en: Frogs’ legs cooked in butter with finely chopped garlic and parsley, commonly served with lemon.
definition.zh: 蛙腿轻裹粉后用黄油煎炒，再加入细切蒜和欧芹增香，常配柠檬角。Persillade 提示蒜与欧芹的组合；蛙腿肉质细嫩，介绍时可直接说明主料和调味。

sources.title: Académie du Goût — Cuisses de grenouilles en persillade
Bourg-en-Bresse tourism — Cuisses de grenouilles en persillade

examples.en: The frogs’ legs are cooked in butter with garlic and parsley, with lemon on the side.
examples.zh: 蛙腿用黄油、蒜和欧芹烹制，旁边配柠檬。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: Chicken pieces cooked with a sauce of mushrooms, shallots, white wine and tomato, often finished with herbs.
definition.zh: 先将鸡块煎上色，再搭配蘑菇、红葱头、白葡萄酒与番茄制成的酱汁烹调，常以龙蒿、欧芹等香草收尾。Chasseur 是法式猎人风味酱汁的提示，蘑菇和红葱头是介绍中的重点。

sources.title: Chloé Charles / Académie du Goût — Poulet sauté chasseur

examples.en: The chicken chasseur comes with mushrooms, shallots and a white-wine tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 法式猎人鸡配蘑菇、红葱头，以及白葡萄酒和番茄制成的酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.
Avoid the ambiguous alias hunter’s chicken, also used for a British barbecue-sauce dish.

entries.zh: 法式盐渍猪肉炖小扁豆

definition.en: Lightly salt-cured pork, such as hock or belly, slowly cooked and served with lentils and aromatic vegetables.
definition.zh: 先把盐渍猪肘、猪五花等适当浸泡脱盐，再慢煮至软嫩，搭配小扁豆和芳香蔬菜。Petit salé 指轻度盐渍的猪肉，而 lentilles 在这里是小扁豆，不是中国菜里常见的鲜扁豆荚。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Petit salé aux lentilles

examples.en: This dish combines slow-cooked salt-cured pork with tender lentils.
examples.zh: 这道菜把慢煮盐渍猪肉与软嫩的小扁豆搭配在一起。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: Cabbage filled with a savoury stuffing, commonly minced pork, herbs and sometimes rice, then slowly cooked in stock.
definition.zh: 将包心菜叶烫软，包入猪肉馅、香草，有时加入米饭等配料，再放入高汤中慢慢烹熟。既可做成整颗包心菜，也可分成单人份，入口结合柔软菜叶与多汁肉馅。

examples.en: The cabbage is stuffed with pork, rice and herbs, then gently cooked in stock.
examples.zh: 包心菜内填猪肉、米饭和香草，再用高汤慢慢煮熟。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Explanation and service example are original teaching text; examples illustrate a preparation, not a promise about every restaurant recipe.

definition.en: A baked milk-and-egg custard turned out of its mould so the liquid caramel coats the top and pools around it.
definition.zh: 把牛奶、鸡蛋和糖调成布丁液，倒入底部铺有焦糖的模具，隔水烘烤凝固后冷藏。脱模倒扣时，焦糖成为流动酱汁；这与表面有脆糖壳、通常连烤皿上桌的 crème brûlée 不同。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Classic crème caramel

examples.en: The crème caramel is a smooth vanilla custard with a light caramel sauce.
examples.zh: 这款焦糖布丁是顺滑的香草蛋奶布丁，配一层流动的焦糖酱。

sources.title: Liège Tourism — The Authentic Liège Waffle

examples.en: The Liège waffle has pearl sugar baked into the dough, so it is sweet on its own.
examples.zh: 列日华夫饼的面团中烤入了珍珠糖，所以原味就有甜味。

definition.en: Swiss Alpine pasta with potatoes and cheese, often topped with fried onions and served with apple purée.
definition.zh: 将通心粉、土豆和奶酪煮成柔润的瑞士高山家常菜，常撒炸脆或炒香的洋葱，旁边配苹果泥。土豆与意面同在一盘，是辨认它的要点；苹果泥提供果香和酸甜，通常另放。

sources.title: Emmentaler AOP Switzerland — Emmentaler Alpine macaroni

examples.en: The Alpine macaroni includes potatoes and cheese, with apple purée on the side.
examples.zh: 这道高山通心粉含土豆和奶酪，旁边配苹果泥。

definition.en: A Swiss cold oat dish with grated apple, milk or yoghurt and nuts.
definition.zh: 瑞士经典冷食燕麦，先将燕麦浸软，再拌入磨碎的苹果、乳制品和坚果等。早期做法使用炼乳及柠檬汁，现代常换成牛奶或酸奶；口感柔软湿润，适合早餐或早午餐，不是烘烤成脆块的格兰诺拉。

sources.title: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Muesli: the world-famous Swiss breakfast classic

examples.en: Our Bircher muesli is a cold oat dish with grated apple and yoghurt.
examples.zh: 我们的 Bircher 燕麦是冷食，拌有磨碎的苹果和酸奶。

definition.en: A Swedish casserole of sliced potatoes, onions, spiced sprats and cream.
definition.zh: 把细切土豆、洋葱、香料腌渍的小鱼和奶油分层焗烤，常以面包屑形成表层。传统用鱼在瑞典称 ansjovis，通常是 sprat，并不是地中海菜常见的 anchovy；奶油土豆吸收腌鱼的咸鲜。

examples.en: Jansson’s temptation is a creamy potato bake with onions and spiced sprats.
examples.zh: Jansson’s temptation 是加入洋葱和香料腌小鱼的奶油土豆焗烤。

definition.en: Finnish salmon soup with potatoes, a little cream and fresh dill.
definition.zh: 芬兰常见的三文鱼汤，以三文鱼块、土豆和少量奶油构成主体，常加入韭葱、胡萝卜等蔬菜，最后用莳萝提香。汤里保留鱼肉和蔬菜块，整体柔和鲜美，既可作为午餐汤，也常见于传统餐馆。

sources.title: Visit Finland — What to eat in Finland: Lohikeitto

examples.en: The salmon soup comes with potatoes and fresh dill in a lightly creamy broth.
examples.zh: 这道三文鱼汤配有土豆和新鲜莳萝，汤底带淡淡奶油香。

definition.zh: 把鸡蛋、培根、香肠和吐司，与番茄、茄汁焗豆、蘑菇等热食组合成一盘的早餐。鸡蛋可煎、炒或水波煮，部分版本还配黑布丁血肠。服务时可先介绍本店包含哪些项目，再询问客人喜欢的鸡蛋做法。

definition.en: Sliced roast beef served as a Sunday lunch with gravy, Yorkshire pudding and vegetables.
definition.zh: 将整块牛肉烘烤、静置后切片，搭配肉汁、约克郡布丁和蔬菜组成的周日午餐。牛肉是这条菜名的明确主角；介绍时可说明肉的熟度与当天配菜。这里的 Yorkshire pudding 是咸味烤面糊配菜。

examples.en: The roast beef Sunday lunch comes with Yorkshire pudding, vegetables and gravy.

definition.en: Cooked sausages served over mashed potatoes, often finished with onion gravy.
definition.zh: 将煎烤熟的香肠放在土豆泥上，常配带甜香的洋葱肉汁。Bangers 是英式口语中的香肠，mash 在这里指 mashed potatoes。入口有香肠的肉香、柔滑土豆泥与浓汁，适合练习解释菜单里的口语名称。

sources.title: Gordon Ramsay — Bangers & Mash in 10 Minutes

examples.en: Bangers and mash is our sausage dish with mashed potatoes and onion gravy.

definition.zh: 以大块奶酪、外皮酥脆的面包和腌洋葱等酸味配料组成的冷食午餐。奶酪的浓香与腌菜的酸爽形成对比，可以把面包与奶酪、腌菜搭着吃。菜名中的 ploughman 原指犁田的人，点餐时指的是这类冷盘组合。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation / Rosemary Howe — Stilton Ploughman’s Lunch

examples.en: Our ploughman’s lunch is a cold plate of cheese, crusty bread and pickled onions.

definition.zh: 牛肉块与洋葱、艾尔啤酒和高汤慢炖成浓汁馅料，再盖上或包入面皮烤熟。Ale 在这里是参与烹调的啤酒，带来麦芽风味；steak 指牛肉馅料，不表示上桌的是一整块煎牛排。

sources.title: Cornish Pasty Association — Make Your Own Genuine Cornish Pasty

examples.en: The Cornish pasty is filled with beef, potato, swede and onion.

sources.title: Tom Aikens / Great British Chefs — Fish Pie

examples.en: Our fish pie has a creamy sauce and a golden mashed-potato topping.

scones with jam and clotted cream

definition.en: Plain or fruit scones served with thick clotted cream and jam.
definition.zh: 将原味或含葡萄干的司康烤至松酥，剖开后配凝脂奶油和果酱食用，是英式茶点常见组合。司康由面粉、黄油、奶类和膨松剂制成，口感介于面包与酥点之间；这里的 clotted cream 指质地浓厚的凝脂奶油。

sources.title: William Drabble / Great British Chefs — Fruit Scones

examples.en: The warm scones come with clotted cream and strawberry jam.
examples.zh: 温热的司康配凝脂奶油和草莓果酱。

definition.en: A pastry tart with a sweet golden-syrup filling thickened with breadcrumbs and brightened with lemon.
definition.zh: 在酥皮挞壳内填入金黄糖浆、面包屑和柠檬调成的馅，再烤至凝结。面包屑吸收糖浆，形成湿润而略有颗粒感的内馅；柠檬带来清香。菜名虽有 treacle，常见配方的主角是 golden syrup 金黄糖浆。

examples.en: The treacle tart has a sweet syrup filling with a little lemon.

definition.zh: 以浓奶油、糖和柠檬为主要风味，加热调匀后冷藏成柔软凝固状的甜点。口感浓滑，柠檬的酸香很突出，常装在小杯或小碗中，配酥饼或莓果。介绍时可用 creamy and tangy 描述其奶香与酸爽。

sources.title: Chris Mosler / Great British Chefs — Summer Pudding

examples.en: The summer pudding is made with berries and bread soaked in their juice.

sources.title: GBC Kitchen / Great British Chefs — Strawberry Trifle

examples.en: The trifle has layers of sponge cake, strawberries, custard and whipped cream.

examples.en: The banoffee pie combines banana, soft caramel and whipped cream.

examples.en: Spotted dick is a steamed fruit pudding, served with warm custard.
examples.zh: 这道葡萄干蒸布丁配温热蛋奶酱上桌。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked currants, suet dough, steaming and custard; the source specifies vegetable suet, and no dish-wide dietary guarantee is inferred.

definition.en: Fluffy griddle pancakes made with buttermilk, often served with butter and maple syrup.
definition.zh: 用酪乳加入面粉和鸡蛋面糊，再用泡打粉、小苏打等膨松剂做成的厚松饼。面糊倒在热铁板或平底锅上煎成两面金黄，内部松软，酪乳带轻微酸香；常叠放并配黄油和枫糖浆。

sources.title: Charlotte Rutledge / King Arthur Baking — Buttermilk Pancakes

examples.en: The buttermilk pancakes come in a stack with butter and maple syrup.
examples.zh: 酪乳松饼叠放上桌，配黄油和枫糖浆。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked buttermilk batter, chemical leaveners and griddle method; the country is a menu-learning grouping, not an origin assertion.

definition.en: Bread soaked in an egg-and-milk mixture, then pan-fried until golden.
definition.zh: 将较厚的面包片吸足鸡蛋与牛奶混合液，再用黄油煎至表面金黄、内部柔软。美式早午餐常做成甜味，配枫糖浆或莓果；学菜名时重点记住它是浸蛋奶液后煎成的面包。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to Make French Toast

examples.en: Our French toast is golden outside and soft in the centre.
examples.zh: 我们的法式吐司外面金黄，中心柔软。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked soaking and pan-frying; placed in American brunch learning context without an origin claim. Eggy bread is not added as an exact alias.

definition.en: Poached eggs and spinach on toasted English muffins, topped with hollandaise.
definition.zh: 在烤过的英式松饼上铺熟菠菜和水波蛋，再淋荷兰酱的早午餐做法。它与 Eggs Benedict 的常见区别是用菠菜替代火腿；Florentine 在这类菜单语境中提示菠菜元素。荷兰酱带黄油香和轻微酸味。

sources.title: Sally Abé / Great British Chefs — Eggs Florentine

examples.en: Eggs Florentine comes with spinach, poached eggs and hollandaise on an English muffin.
examples.zh: 这道菠菜水波蛋以英式松饼垫底，配菠菜、水波蛋和荷兰酱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked the modern brunch form and spinach/ham distinction. US category denotes the learning menu, not birthplace or the only Florentine preparation.

definition.en: Chopped corned beef, potatoes and onion browned together in a frying pan.
definition.zh: 把熟的腌咸牛肉与土豆、洋葱切小块，在平底锅中煎炒并压出焦香表面，常作为早餐或早午餐，也可加煎蛋。Hash 在这里指切碎混合煎制的菜；corned beef 是腌咸牛肉，不是玉米牛肉。

sources.title: Christine Gallary / The Kitchn — Corned Beef Hash

examples.en: The corned beef hash has diced potatoes and beef with a crisp, browned edge.
examples.zh: 这道咸牛肉土豆杂烩有牛肉丁和土豆丁，煎出的边缘焦香。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked chef-trained recipe author’s potato, onion and corned-beef version and optional fried egg.

definition.en: A sandwich named for its three main fillings: bacon, lettuce and tomato.
definition.zh: BLT 是 bacon、lettuce、tomato 的首字母，即培根、生菜和番茄三种主要馅料。常配蛋黄酱夹在面包中，培根的咸香、叶菜的脆感和番茄的多汁形成对比。介绍时把缩写展开，客人就容易理解。

sources.title: GBC Kitchen / Great British Chefs — Ultimate BLT Sandwich

examples.en: BLT stands for bacon, lettuce and tomato; it comes with mayonnaise.
examples.zh: BLT 指培根、生菜和番茄，这份还配蛋黄酱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked core fillings and mayonnaise; the source’s confit tomatoes and herb mayonnaise are not universal requirements.

definition.en: A layered toasted sandwich with chicken or turkey, bacon, tomato, lettuce and mayonnaise.
definition.zh: 常用三片烤面包叠出两层馅料，夹鸡肉或火鸡肉、培根、番茄、生菜和蛋黄酱，再切成小块固定上桌。它的重点是多层结构与禽肉、培根组合，部分版本会再加鸡蛋。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — James Beard on Making Super Sandwiches

examples.en: Our club sandwich has chicken, bacon and salad between three slices of toast.
examples.zh: 我们的总会三明治用三片吐司夹鸡肉、培根和沙拉蔬菜。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked modern triple-slice format and chicken/turkey alternatives; egg is a variation.

entries.zh: 鲁本咸牛肉酸菜三明治

definition.en: A toasted rye sandwich with corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and a creamy dressing.
definition.zh: 把咸牛肉、瑞士风格奶酪、德式酸菜与俄式或千岛沙拉酱夹入黑麦面包，煎烤至表面焦脆、奶酪融化。酸菜的酸味平衡肉和奶酪的浓香；部分店也用烟熏腌牛肉 pastrami 制作。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — James Beard on Making Super Sandwiches

examples.en: The Reuben has corned beef, sauerkraut and melted cheese on rye bread.
examples.zh: 鲁本三明治用黑麦面包，夹咸牛肉、酸菜和融化的奶酪。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked corned beef/pastrami options and Thousand Island dressing with Emeril; Russian dressing also appears in Beard’s discussion. No origin claim.

definition.en: A long roll filled with thinly sliced or chopped hot beef and melted cheese.
definition.zh: 把薄切或切碎的牛肉在铁板上煎熟，拌上融化的奶酪，装入长形面包。常见奶酪选择有奶酪酱、美式奶酪或普罗沃洛内奶酪，炒洋葱可选。Cheesesteak 在这里是一种热三明治的名称。

sources.title: Visit Philadelphia — A Guide to the Best Cheesesteaks in Philadelphia

examples.en: Would you like sautéed onions with your Philly cheesesteak?
examples.zh: 您的费城牛肉奶酪长包要加炒洋葱吗？

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Official tourism source verifies sliced/chopped beef, long roll, cheese alternatives and optional onions.

definition.en: Cooked shrimp served with creamy grits, often accompanied by a savoury pan sauce.
definition.zh: 把煮成软滑浓稠状的玉米糁 grits 作为底或配菜，搭配煎炒鲜虾和鲜味酱汁。部分版本在玉米糁中加奶酪，或在虾汁中加培根、烟熏香肠。它能同时呈现虾肉的弹嫩与玉米糁的绵滑。

sources.title: John Besh / James Beard Foundation — Duck Camp Shrimp and Grits
Jim Shirley / James Beard Foundation — Spiced Shrimp with Smoked Gouda Grits

examples.en: The shrimp are served over creamy grits with a savoury sauce.
examples.zh: 鲜虾铺在软滑的玉米糁粥上，配鲜味酱汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked shrimp with grits and sauce; cheese and meat additions are presented as variations.

definition.en: A Louisiana chicken-and-sausage stew with a browned roux and aromatic vegetables, served with rice.
definition.zh: 以鸡肉、烟熏香肠、洋葱、芹菜和青椒熬煮的路易斯安那浓汤，常以炒成棕色的油脂面粉糊 roux 打底。长时间炖煮让香味融合，上桌时配另煮的米饭；这是 gumbo 家族中的鸡肉香肠版本。

sources.title: Explore Louisiana — Chicken and Sausage Gumbo

examples.en: Our chicken and sausage gumbo is a rich stew served with rice.
examples.zh: 我们的鸡肉香肠甘博是一道浓郁炖汤，配米饭食用。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Official tourism recipe verifies browned roux and separate cooked rice. Generic gumbo is deliberately not an alias for this subtype.

definition.en: A seasoned one-pot rice dish cooked with vegetables and a combination of meat, sausage or seafood.
definition.zh: 让大米与高汤、洋葱、芹菜、青椒及肉类或海鲜在同一锅中焖熟，米粒吸收调味汁。鸡肉、烟熏香肠、猪肉或虾可组成不同版本。与通常把汤浇在饭上的 gumbo 相比，jambalaya 的米饭直接参与整锅烹调。

sources.title: Explore Louisiana — Louisiana’s Most Famous Dishes
Patrick Mould / Explore Louisiana — Cajun Jambalaya

examples.en: In jambalaya, the rice cooks in the same pot as the meat and vegetables.
examples.zh: Jambalaya 的米饭是和肉、蔬菜在同一锅里焖熟的。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked one-pot rice method against tourism comparison and chef recipe. Generic term stays broad; no particular protein or roux is required by the definition.

definition.en: Chicken pieces coated in seasoned flour and fried until the outside is crisp.
definition.zh: 把鸡肉块调味后裹上带香料的面粉，再用油炸或半煎炸的方式做出酥脆外层。经典版本常使用带骨鸡块，外皮焦香、内部多汁；不同厨房会用盐水或酪乳预处理，风味和裹粉厚度各有做法。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — Juanita Dean’s Southern Fried Chicken
The Splendid Table — Southern Fried Chicken

examples.en: The Southern fried chicken has a crisp, seasoned flour coating.
examples.zh: 这份南方炸鸡裹着调味面粉，外层酥脆。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked flour coating and skillet frying; seasonings and preparation vary, so no universal buttermilk requirement.

definition.en: A tomato-based seafood stew combining fish and shellfish in a savoury broth.
definition.zh: 以番茄、洋葱、蒜和葡萄酒熬出汤底，再加入鱼肉与虾、蟹、蛤蜊或贻贝等海鲜的炖汤。常见于旧金山意式海鲜餐厅，重点是番茄汤汁与多种海鲜的鲜味；具体海鲜组合可随供应变化。

examples.en: The cioppino brings fish and shellfish together in a tomato-based broth.
examples.zh: 这道 cioppino 用番茄汤底把鱼肉和贝虾类海鲜炖在一起。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked tomato, wine and mixed seafood; Dungeness crab and any single shellfish are not universal requirements.

definition.en: A pastry pie filled with pecans in a sweet, softly set egg-and-syrup mixture.
definition.zh: 在派皮中填入碧根果、鸡蛋、黄油和糖浆调成的甜馅，烘烤后切片上桌。上层坚果带烘烤香，下面的馅柔软浓甜，常配奶油或香草冰淇淋。Pecan 指碧根果，也称美洲山核桃。

sources.title: Susan Reid / King Arthur Baking — Pecan Pie

examples.en: The pecan pie has a nutty top and a soft, sweet filling.
examples.zh: 碧根果派上层有坚果香，内馅柔软香甜。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked pecans, egg-and-syrup filling and pastry; no nut-free or dietary substitution claim.

definition.en: Rich chocolate tray-baked squares, ranging from dense and fudgy to lightly cake-like.
definition.zh: 把巧克力或可可、黄油、糖、鸡蛋和面粉调成面糊，在平烤盘里烘烤后切块的甜点。口感可偏湿润绵密，也可略带蛋糕般蓬松感。Fudgy 描述浓密湿润的口感，不表示必须夹有软糖馅。

sources.title: PJ Hamel / King Arthur Baking — Fudge Brownies
King Arthur Baking — Types of Brownies

examples.en: These chocolate brownies have a rich flavour and a moist, fudgy centre.
examples.zh: 这些巧克力布朗尼风味浓郁，中心湿润绵密。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: 2026-10-27: Browsed source review; Checked tray-baked chocolate batter and texture range; nuts are not inferred from the name.

definition.en: An aromatic plant used for its crisp bulb, feathery leaves or seeds. Its anise-like flavour works in salads, roasted vegetables, fish dishes and sausage seasoning.
definition.zh: 带有类似茴香酒香气的植物，菜单中的 fennel 可能指脆嫩的球状基部、细叶或籽。球茴香可切薄片做沙拉，也可烤制或焖煮；向客人介绍时，应说明本菜使用哪个部位。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook fennel

examples.en: The fish comes with shaved fennel, which adds a crisp texture and a gentle anise flavour.
examples.zh: 这道鱼配茴香薄片，口感脆爽，带有淡淡的茴香香气。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Fennel bulb, fennel fronds and fennel seeds are parts of the plant, not interchangeable exact aliases.

definition.en: A layered allium vegetable with a white stalk and green leaves. Cooking softens its onion-like flavour into a gentle sweetness, useful in soups, pies and side dishes.
definition.zh: 葱属蔬菜，白色与浅绿色部分层层包裹，带有较温和的葱香；煮熟后更柔软、甜润。常用于浓汤、咸派或蔬菜配菜，深绿色较韧的部分也可用于熬汤底。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook leeks

examples.en: The soup is made with leeks and potatoes, so it has a mild onion flavour.
examples.zh: 这款汤用西洋韭葱和土豆制作，因此带有温和的葱香。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A knobbly root vegetable with a celery-like, nutty flavour. It is crisp when raw and becomes mildly sweet when cooked, making it useful for slaws, purées and soups.
definition.zh: 外形粗糙的根用蔬菜，也称 celery root，风味近似芹菜并带坚果气息。生食爽脆，可切丝做沙拉；熟后略甜，适合打成泥、煮汤或烤制，是解释配菜时常见的食材词。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to cook celeriac

examples.en: The purée underneath the beef is celeriac; it has a gentle celery flavour.
examples.zh: 牛肉下面的蔬菜泥是根芹泥，带有淡淡的芹菜风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A root vegetable valued for its earthy sweetness. It becomes particularly sweet when roasted and can also be mashed, puréed or blended into a warming soup.
definition.zh: 西餐常用的根类蔬菜，带有根茎的泥土气息与自然甜味。烤制能突出甜润口感，也常用于蔬菜泥、浓汤或冬季配菜；介绍时可强调它与土豆不同的甜香。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook parsnips

examples.en: The roasted parsnips are naturally sweet and have lightly caramelised edges.
examples.zh: 烤欧洲防风草根本身带甜味，边缘有轻微焦糖化的香气。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A vegetable served as slender spears with tender tips. Green and white varieties appear on menus, often grilled, blanched or paired with eggs and butter-based sauces.
definition.zh: 以嫩茎和笋尖食用的蔬菜，菜单上常见绿芦笋与白芦笋。可焯、烤或煎制，适合作前菜或主菜配菜，也常搭配鸡蛋与荷兰酱；介绍时可说明品种和熟后是否保留脆感。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook asparagus

examples.en: Our green asparagus is grilled and served with hollandaise on the side.
examples.zh: 我们的绿芦笋采用烤制，荷兰酱另放在旁边。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A compact head of pale, slightly bitter chicory leaves, also called witloof. Its leaves can be served raw, while whole heads are often braised or baked.
definition.zh: 叶片紧密包合、颜色乳白至淡黄的菊苣，称 witloof，带有清爽苦味。可拆叶生食，也可整颗焖煮或焗烤；英语 endive 与 chicory 的用法因地区而异，不能都视为这一种。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Salad leaf variety guide

examples.en: The Belgian endive is braised until tender, with a pleasant bitter edge.
examples.zh: 这道比利时菊苣焖煮至软嫩，仍保留一点清爽的苦味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Do not alias broad endive, chicory, escarole or frisée to this specific pale-headed vegetable.

definition.en: A leafy green with a distinct peppery bite, called arugula in American English. It adds freshness to salads and is also used over pizza or with pasta.
definition.zh: 带有明显胡椒般辛香的绿叶菜，英式英语称 rocket，美式英语通常称 arugula。常生食做沙拉，也可撒在披萨上或拌入意面；适合用 peppery 向客人解释其风味。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Salad leaf variety guide

examples.en: The rocket on top adds a fresh, peppery flavour to the pizza.
examples.zh: 披萨上面的芝麻菜增添了清新的胡椒般辛香。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
This entry covers the culinary plant sense of rocket.

definition.en: A mushroom with a distinctive honeycomb-like cap and rich, earthy, nutty flavour. Cooked morels are used in sauces, with poultry or alongside spring vegetables.
definition.zh: 菌盖有蜂窝般凹凸纹理的食用菌，风味浓郁，带泥土、坚果与鲜香。餐厅常将其充分烹熟后加入酱汁、搭配禽肉或春季蔬菜；也有干燥后泡发使用的形式。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook morels

examples.en: The chicken is served with a morel sauce, which adds a rich mushroom flavour.
examples.zh: 这道鸡肉配羊肚菌酱，带来浓郁的菌菇鲜香。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Descriptions concern culinary morels; this is not a wild-mushroom identification guide.

definition.en: A spice made from the red stigmas of the saffron crocus. It gives food a golden colour and a distinctive hay-like aroma, often in rice and sauces.
definition.zh: 由番红花的红色柱头制成的香料，通常先浸泡以释放颜色与香气。能为米饭、酱汁和甜点带来金黄色泽及近似干草的细致香气；它与姜黄是不同的食材。

examples.en: The risotto gets its golden colour and delicate aroma from saffron.
examples.zh: 这款烩饭的金黄色泽和细致香气来自藏红花。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Turmeric is not an alias for saffron.

definition.en: An aromatic culinary herb used fresh or dried. Its small leaves season roast dishes, sauces and stews, and some varieties also work in fruit desserts.
definition.zh: 香气细致的烹饪香草，鲜叶或干叶都可用于调味，常见于烤肉、炖菜和酱汁。细小叶片也能为水果甜点增添草本气息；菜单中的 thyme 通常指香草本身而非某款酱汁。

sources.title: University of Delaware — Herbs and spices with foods

examples.en: The roast chicken is seasoned with thyme for a gentle herbal aroma.
examples.zh: 这道烤鸡用百里香调味，带有温和的草本香气。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A strongly aromatic herb with narrow, needle-like leaves. It is often cooked with roast meat or potatoes, and can also flavour bread or selected desserts.
definition.zh: 叶片细长、近似针形的香草，香气较鲜明，常与肉类、土豆一同烤制，也用于佛卡夏等面包。服务介绍可用 aromatic herb 说明它提供的是草本香气，而不是辣椒式辣味。

examples.en: These potatoes are roasted with rosemary and garlic, giving them a fragrant finish.
examples.zh: 这些土豆与迷迭香和蒜一起烤制，香气浓郁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A culinary herb with grey-green leaves and a pronounced herbal flavour. It is used with roast poultry, stuffings, pumpkin and butter sauces for pasta or gnocchi.
definition.zh: 常用于西餐的灰绿色叶片香草，草本风味鲜明，可为烤禽肉、填馅和南瓜菜肴调味。也常与黄油配成意面或意式团子的酱汁；此处 sage 指食材，不是“智者”。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Gnocchi with brown butter and sage pesto

examples.en: The ravioli are finished with sage butter, which gives the sauce a fragrant herbal flavour.
examples.zh: 这款意式饺子最后拌入鼠尾草黄油，酱汁带有芬芳的草本风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: An aromatic herb with narrow leaves and an anise-like note. Common in French cooking, it flavours béarnaise and is used with chicken, eggs and fish.
definition.zh: 叶片细长、带类似茴香气息的香草，在法式料理中很常见。可为鸡肉、鱼和蛋类增香，也是伯那西酱的重要风味来源；介绍酱汁时，可说明其清晰的草本香气。

examples.en: The tarragon in this sauce gives it a gentle anise note that complements the chicken.
examples.zh: 酱汁中的龙蒿带有淡淡的茴香气息，与鸡肉相衬。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A tender culinary herb widely used in northern and eastern European cooking. Its leaves flavour cured salmon, potato salads, pickles and yoghurt-based sauces or dips.
definition.zh: 叶片柔嫩的烹饪香草，在北欧及东欧菜肴中十分常见，常用于腌三文鱼、土豆沙拉、腌菜和酸奶酱。服务时可说明它是调味香草，细叶外观相近也不代表与茴香是同一种食材。

examples.en: Our cured salmon is flavoured with dill, which adds a fresh herbal note.
examples.zh: 我们的腌三文鱼用莳萝调味，带来清新的草本香气。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A spice grated or ground from a hard seed. Small amounts add aromatic depth to creamy potato dishes, pasta fillings, milk-based sauces and baked desserts.
definition.zh: 由坚硬种仁磨粉或刨碎后使用的香料，常少量加入奶香酱汁、土豆焗菜、意面馅料或烘焙甜点。介绍时可强调它带来的是香料气息；本条采用烹饪词义，不指足球中的穿裆动作。

examples.en: There is a little nutmeg in the potato gratin to give the cream a subtle spice note.
examples.zh: 这款奶油焗土豆加了少量肉豆蔻，为奶香增添细微的香料气息。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: An aromatic leaf used to infuse soups, stocks, stews and sauces. Often included in a bouquet garni, it contributes herbal depth during cooking rather than a fresh garnish.
definition.zh: 用于熬煮时浸出香气的调味叶，常加入汤底、炖菜和酱汁，也常放在香草束中。它提供的是缓慢释放的草本层次；向客人解释菜肴风味时，可说明它参与了汤汁的熬制。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Bay leaf recipes

examples.en: The stew is slowly cooked with bay leaf for a deeper herbal flavour.
examples.zh: 这道炖菜加入月桂叶慢煮，让草本风味更有层次。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A coarse wheat milling product, commonly made from durum wheat. It brings texture to pasta and bread and can also be cooked into a soft pudding or porridge.
definition.zh: 通常由杜兰小麦磨制的粗粒小麦粉，颜色偏淡黄，常用于意面、面包，也可加液体煮成柔软的布丁或粥。菜品介绍应结合实际做法，不能把 semolina 一律解释成某一种面食。

examples.en: These Roman-style gnocchi are made with semolina, so their texture differs from potato gnocchi.
examples.zh: 这些罗马式团子用杜兰小麦粗粒粉制作，口感与土豆团子不同。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
The entry describes the durum-wheat form commonly used in these menus, not every product called semolina worldwide.

definition.en: A rich Italian dairy ingredient made by thickening cream. Its smooth, mild character suits tiramisu and other desserts, while it can also enrich risotto or savoury sauces.
definition.zh: 由奶油凝聚制成的浓稠意式乳制品，通常称马斯卡彭奶酪，质地顺滑、奶味柔和。既是提拉米苏的重要原料，也能用于咸味酱汁或烩饭，增加浓润口感。

examples.en: The tiramisu has a smooth mascarpone cream between the coffee-soaked biscuit layers.
examples.zh: 这款提拉米苏的咖啡浸饼干层之间，夹着顺滑的马斯卡彭奶油馅。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A family of Italian sheep-milk cheeses, including regional styles such as Romano and Sardo. Aged versions can be firm and savoury, suitable for grating over pasta.
definition.zh: 意大利绵羊奶酪的一类名称，包含 Romano、Sardo 等地区品种，并非单指一种固定奶酪。熟成后的品种可较硬、咸鲜，常刨碎搭配意面；介绍时应尽量说清具体品种。

sources.title: Eataly — The milk behind the cheese

examples.en: We finish this pasta with Pecorino Romano, a savoury sheep-milk cheese.
examples.zh: 这款意面最后撒上佩科里诺罗马诺奶酪，是一种咸鲜的绵羊奶酪。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Pecorino Romano is one member of the pecorino family, not an exact alias for the entire category; Parmesan is not an alias.

definition.en: An Italian stretched-curd cheese made from cow or buffalo milk. Fresh versions are soft and milky, served in salads or used in cooked dishes such as pizza.
definition.zh: 通过拉伸凝乳制成的意式奶酪，可使用牛奶或水牛奶。新鲜版本柔软、带奶香，常用于卡普雷塞沙拉，也广泛用于披萨等热菜；介绍时应说明本店所用品种，而不能默认全是水牛奶。

examples.en: Our Caprese uses fresh cow-milk mozzarella with tomatoes and basil.
examples.zh: 我们的卡普雷塞沙拉使用新鲜牛奶马苏里拉奶酪，搭配番茄和罗勒。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Buffalo mozzarella and fior di latte are specific milk-based forms, not exact aliases for all mozzarella.

definition.en: Italian cured pork belly, seasoned and matured before use. Its fat and savoury flavour enrich sauces, fillings and pasta dishes; it comes from a different cut than guanciale.
definition.zh: 以猪腹部肉腌制并熟成的意式肉制品，肥瘦相间，常为酱汁、馅料和意面提供油脂与咸鲜味。它与取自猪颊或下颌部的 guanciale 部位不同，服务时应明确它属于猪肉。

examples.en: This pasta contains pancetta, which is cured pork belly and adds a savoury richness.
examples.zh: 这款意面含有意式腌猪腹肉，能增加咸鲜与浓润口感。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Bacon and guanciale are not exact aliases for pancetta.

definition.en: Cured pork jowl used in Roman cooking, particularly carbonara and amatriciana. Its rich fat and pronounced cured flavour form an important part of the pasta sauce.
definition.zh: 以猪颊、下颌附近肉腌制熟成的意式肉制品，油脂丰富、腌肉风味鲜明。常用于卡邦尼和阿马特里恰纳等罗马传统意面；与猪腹肉制成的 pancetta 是不同部位。

examples.en: Our carbonara uses guanciale, a cured pork jowl with a rich, savoury flavour.
examples.zh: 我们的卡邦尼使用意式腌猪颊肉，风味浓郁咸鲜。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Pancetta and bacon are not exact aliases for guanciale.

definition.en: A bivalve shellfish valued for its sweet, tender flesh. It is often seared or poached; some preparations also include the roe, known as coral.
definition.zh: 双壳贝类，肉质细嫩、带自然甜味，西餐常煎制、汆煮或烤制。部分做法也使用称为 coral 的贝黄；菜单上应区分整只带壳呈现还是只供应贝肉，干贝则是另一种加工形态。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook scallops

examples.en: The scallops are pan-seared and served with a smooth celeriac purée.
examples.zh: 这道扇贝采用香煎做法，配顺滑的根芹泥。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A bivalve shellfish often cooked and served in its shell. Steaming releases flavourful juices that become part of a broth or sauce, as in moules marinières.
definition.zh: 又常称青口的双壳贝类，西餐经常带壳蒸煮并连同汤汁上桌。烹调释放的贝汁可成为汤或酱汁的一部分，也能去壳加入意面；mussels 为菜单上常见的复数形式。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook mussels

examples.en: The mussels are steamed in white wine and served in their cooking broth.
examples.zh: 这道贻贝用白葡萄酒蒸煮，并连同烹煮汤汁一起上桌。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A name for several types of bivalve shellfish used in cooking. Their flesh and juices add seafood flavour to pasta, rice dishes, chowders and sauces.
definition.zh: 烹饪中对多种蛤类双壳贝的称呼，并非只指某一个品种。贝肉及其汁液能为意面、米饭、浓汤和酱汁增加海鲜风味；向客人介绍时可同时说明品种、是否带壳及所配汤汁。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook clams

examples.en: The spaghetti is tossed with clams and their juices for a clean seafood flavour.
examples.zh: 这款长意面拌入蛤蜊及其原汁，海鲜风味清晰。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Clam is a broad culinary group; individual species and razor clams are not added as exact aliases.

definition.en: A laminated pastry made by repeatedly folding dough and fat into layers. Steam separates those layers during baking, producing a light, crisp shell for sweet or savoury dishes.
definition.zh: 将面团与油脂反复折叠、擀开形成层次的面皮，烘烤时蒸汽使薄层分开，产生轻盈酥脆的结构。常用于威灵顿、千层酥或派顶；与逐张铺叠的菲罗面皮做法不同。

sources.title: King Arthur Baking — Classic puff pastry
Great British Chefs — How to choose pastry

examples.en: The beef is wrapped in puff pastry, which bakes into crisp, flaky layers.
examples.zh: 牛肉包在起酥面皮中，烤后形成层层酥脆的外壳。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: Extremely thin sheets of pastry layered with fat before baking. They create a delicate, crackly crust in sweet and savoury dishes such as baklava and spanakopita.
definition.zh: 薄如纸张的面皮，通常逐张刷油脂并铺叠后烘烤，形成细薄而脆的外层。可用于甜味的巴克拉瓦，也用于菠菜奶酪派；它依靠叠放薄片形成层次，口感与起酥面皮不同。

sources.title: Institute of Culinary Education — Four types of pastry dough

examples.en: The spinach filling is wrapped in layers of filo pastry for a light, crisp finish.
examples.zh: 菠菜馅包在多层菲罗薄面皮中，烤后轻薄酥脆。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.

definition.en: A pastry made by combining flour and fat into a tender, relatively sturdy dough. Its crumbly texture makes it suitable for pie, tart and quiche cases.
definition.zh: 由面粉与油脂混合成面团的派皮，烤后酥松，结构较适合承托馅料，常用于咸派、果馅派和挞底。它可制成咸味或甜味版本，与明显膨起分层的起酥面皮应分开说明。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to choose pastry

examples.en: The quiche has a shortcrust pastry base with a tender, crumbly texture.
examples.zh: 这款咸派以酥松派皮作底，口感细嫩酥散。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
Pâte brisée, pâte sucrée and pâte sablée are specific pastry styles, not exact aliases for every shortcrust.

definition.en: Small pieces of bread used in cooking, often dried. They can form a crisp coating on meat or fish, add texture to toppings or help bind fillings.
definition.zh: 把面包加工成的碎屑，烹饪中常使用干燥版本，可裹在肉或鱼外形成脆壳，也可撒在表面增加口感或帮助馅料结合。Panko 是其中一种风格，不能与所有面包屑直接画等号。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to crumb meat or fish
Great British Chefs — How to cook with panko breadcrumbs

examples.en: The fish has a breadcrumb coating, which becomes crisp when fried.
examples.zh: 鱼肉外面裹了面包屑，炸后形成酥脆外层。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
This entry covers the food sense, not website navigation. Panko is not an exact alias for all breadcrumbs.

definition.en: In cooking, a flavourful liquid made by simmering ingredients such as bones, meat, fish or vegetables. It provides a base for soups, sauces, braises and risotto.
definition.zh: 在烹饪语境中，指用骨、肉、鱼或蔬菜等原料熬煮取得的风味液体，是汤、酱汁、焖菜与烩饭的基础。应说明 chicken stock、fish stock 或 vegetable stock 等实际来源。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to make chicken stock
Great British Chefs — How to make vegetable stock
Iowa State University — Glossary of cooking terms

examples.en: This risotto is cooked with vegetable stock, which adds flavour as the rice absorbs it.
examples.zh: 这款烩饭用蔬菜高汤煮制，米粒吸收汤汁时也吸收了风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative restaurant preparation.
The culinary sense is explicitly scoped. Inventory, shares and stock management remain different senses; individual stock types are not exact aliases.

definition.en: Firm enough to make a noticeable crunch when bitten, as with raw vegetables, toasted nuts or a crisp topping.
definition.zh: 咬下时有明显脆响和一定咀嚼阻力，常形容生蔬菜、烘烤坚果或脆粒配料。与 crispy 用法有重叠；crunchy 更突出咬碎时的脆响和嚼感，不能一律理解为油炸。

examples.en: The toasted almonds add a crunchy contrast to the soft pear.
examples.zh: 烘烤杏仁增加了爽脆口感，与软嫩的梨形成对比。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
Crunchy and crispy overlap in ordinary usage; no rigid thickness or cooking-method rule is claimed.

definition.en: Separating readily into thin pieces or layers; useful for describing baked pastry and the texture of cooked fish.
definition.zh: 轻轻掰开便分成薄片或薄层的口感，常用于酥皮和熟鱼肉。介绍酥皮时强调层次，介绍鱼肉时强调分片的质地；它描述结构，并不单独说明是否多汁。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — how to cook cod

examples.en: The tart has a flaky pastry base with a warm apple filling.
examples.zh: 这款挞的酥皮底层次分明，里面是温热的苹果馅。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Offering little resistance when cut or chewed; describes food texture rather than a particular level of meat doneness.
definition.zh: 形容食物容易切开、咬断，口感软嫩而不韧硬，可用于肉类和蔬菜。tender 说的是质地，不等于牛排的 rare 或 medium，也不保证肉汁多少。

examples.en: The lamb shoulder is slow-cooked until tender and served with rosemary jus.
examples.zh: 羊肩肉经过慢煮，口感软嫩，配迷迭香肉汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Holding plenty of enjoyable juice or moisture when eaten; used for both fruit and cooked meat.
definition.zh: 咬下时能感到充足汁液，常用来介绍成熟水果或保有肉汁的肉类。它强调水分与汁液，和 tender 的软嫩程度不同；多汁的食物未必同样容易咀嚼。

examples.en: The roast chicken is juicy, with crisp skin and a lemon-herb sauce.
examples.zh: 这份烤鸡肉质多汁，表皮香脆，配柠檬香草酱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Pleasantly moist and juicy to eat; an approving menu word often used for meat, fish and seafood.
definition.zh: 用于称赞食物汁液充足、吃起来鲜美，常见于肉类、鱼类和海鲜介绍。比 juicy 带有更明显的赞赏语气，但不是一种独立烹调方法，也不是熟度等级。

examples.en: The prawns are succulent and served with garlic butter.
examples.zh: 这份虾鲜美多汁，配蒜香黄油。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Requiring repeated chewing before swallowing; this can be enjoyable in bread or toffee, but unwelcome in a tough steak.
definition.zh: 需要多嚼几下才能咽下的质地。形容面包或糖果时可表示有嚼劲，形容牛排时也可能是在说韧、难嚼。服务时要结合食物和客人的语气判断褒贬。

examples.en: Our sourdough has a chewy centre and a crisp crust.
examples.zh: 我们的酸种面包内部有嚼劲，外壳香脆。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Exceptionally smooth in the mouth, suggesting the soft feel of velvet; often used for soups, sauces and purées.
definition.zh: 入口细腻、柔滑，借天鹅绒的触感形容浓汤、酱汁或泥状配菜。与 silky 的丝滑含义接近，并没有严格的浓稠度界线；它本身不说明是否加入奶油。

examples.en: The cauliflower soup is blended until velvety and finished with chives.
examples.zh: 这款花椰菜汤搅打得柔滑细腻，最后撒上细香葱。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Smooth and soft on the palate, with a silk-like impression; commonly used for sauces, custards and purées.
definition.zh: 像丝绸般顺滑柔细的口感，常形容酱汁、蛋奶甜品或蔬菜泥。与 velvety 都强调顺滑，不能只凭这个词判断脂肪含量、奶制品用量或菜品浓度。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — chestnut gnocchi with mushroom velouté

examples.en: The mushroom sauce is silky and coats the gnocchi lightly.
examples.zh: 菌菇酱丝滑细腻，薄薄地裹在意式团子上。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Breaking easily into small crumbs or fragments, as shortbread, some pastry and certain cheeses do.
definition.zh: 轻碰或咬下便容易散成小碎屑，常形容酥饼、部分饼皮或奶酪。crumbly 强调容易散碎；flaky 强调薄层分离，crunchy 则更突出咬碎时的脆响。

examples.en: The shortbread is crumbly, so we serve it beside the lemon cream.
examples.zh: 这款酥饼松酥易碎，因此我们把它放在柠檬奶油旁边。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Soft and sticky, sometimes flowing slightly; often an appealing description of melted cheese, caramel or a dessert centre.
definition.zh: 质地软黏，有时会轻微流动，常用于融化的奶酪、焦糖或甜品夹心。这个词可以是诱人的正面描述，并不等于食物没有煮熟，也不保证一定能拉丝。

examples.en: The warm brownie has a gooey chocolate centre.
examples.zh: 这款温热的布朗尼有软黏浓厚的巧克力内心。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Having a noticeable butter-like flavour or containing generous butter; useful for pastry, sauces and vegetables.
definition.zh: 带明显黄油香味，或形容制作时用了较多黄油的食物，常用于酥皮、酱汁和配菜。作为感官描述时只说明风味，确认实际用料仍应查看菜品配方。

examples.en: The potatoes have a buttery flavour and are finished with parsley.
examples.zh: 这份土豆带有黄油香味，最后加入了欧芹。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Containing nuts or showing a flavour reminiscent of them; a tasting description alone does not establish the ingredients.
definition.zh: 可指含有坚果，也可指风味让人联想到坚果。用于描述奶酪、谷物等时，并不自动表示加入了坚果；客人询问用料时，需要把风味描述与实际配方分开说明。

examples.en: This cheese has a nutty flavour and a firm texture.
examples.zh: 这款奶酪带坚果风味，质地比较紧实。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Suggesting soil or woodland in aroma and flavour; a familiar positive descriptor for mushrooms and some root vegetables.
definition.zh: 香气或味道让人联想到泥土、林地，介绍菌菇时经常是正面描述。它不是说菜里带泥，也不等于苦味；服务时最好点明产生这种气息的食材，帮助客人理解。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — how to cook mushrooms

examples.en: The mushrooms give the risotto an earthy depth of flavour.
examples.zh: 菌菇让这款烩饭有了带林地气息的深厚风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Having an aroma or flavour reminiscent of smoke; describes the sensory result rather than proving a particular smoking process.
definition.zh: 闻起来或尝起来有类似烟熏的气息。smoky 描述感官风味，smoked 则通常表示经过烟熏处理；一道菜也可能因为加入烟熏调料而呈现 smoky 风味。

examples.en: The paprika gives the sauce a smoky flavour.
examples.zh: 红椒粉给这款酱汁带来了烟熏风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
Smoked belongs to the smoke entry as a verb form; it is not an alias of the flavour adjective smoky.

definition.en: Showing a lively, pleasantly sharp taste, often with noticeable acidity; useful for dressings, yogurt and citrus desserts.
definition.zh: 味道鲜明而带令人愉快的酸锐感，常用于沙拉汁、酸奶或柑橘甜品。与笼统的 sour 相比，它常带赞赏意味；不表示辣椒的灼热感，也不必然意味着酸度很高。

examples.en: The tangy yogurt dressing balances the sweetness of the roasted carrots.
examples.zh: 酸爽的酸奶酱平衡了烤胡萝卜的甜味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Full of lively flavour; often used for bright citrus or assertively seasoned sauces, without necessarily meaning chilli heat.
definition.zh: 形容味道鲜明、有活力，常见于柑橘风味或调味鲜明的酱汁。虽然常与柠檬等搭配，但并不专指加了果皮，也不能只凭这个词判断菜品是否辣口。

examples.en: The fish comes with a zesty lemon and herb dressing.
examples.zh: 这份鱼配风味鲜明的柠檬香草汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Having a salty, seawater-like impression; often used to describe oysters and other seafood or brined ingredients.
definition.zh: 带有类似海水或盐水的咸鲜感觉，常用来介绍生蚝、贝类或盐渍食材。重点是盐水般的咸味印象，不是腥味，也不能与 umami 所说的鲜味直接画等号。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — native oyster gratin

examples.en: These oysters have a briny flavour with a gentle sweetness.
examples.zh: 这些生蚝有海水般的咸鲜味，同时带一点柔和的甜味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Describing food on the non-sweet side of a menu, such as cheese tarts or meat pastries; US spelling: savory.
definition.zh: 用于区分咸味菜品与甜点，常形容奶酪挞、肉馅酥点等，未必表示盐放得多。美式拼写是 savory；它的范围比 umami 的鲜味宽，不宜简单互换。

examples.en: We have a savoury tart with spinach and cheese, as well as a sweet fruit tart.
examples.zh: 我们既有菠菜奶酪咸挞，也有甜的水果挞。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
This entry teaches the food adjective. Savory can also name a culinary herb, a separate sense that is not defined here.

definition.en: The savoury basic taste associated with glutamate, distinct from sweetness, sourness, saltiness and bitterness.
definition.zh: 一种独立于甜、酸、咸、苦的基本味觉，常与食物中的谷氨酸相关。介绍高汤、熟成奶酪等时，可用它说明鲜味深度；鲜味强并不等于咸度高。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Comté cheese guide

examples.en: The aged cheese adds extra umami to the sauce.
examples.zh: 熟成奶酪为这款酱汁增加了鲜味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: Pleasantly subtle rather than forceful in flavour or aroma; useful for gently flavoured fish, broths and vegetables.
definition.zh: 形容香气或味道细致、轻柔、不浓烈，常用于清汤、鱼类或蔬菜。它是对精细风味的正面表达，不等于 bland 的寡淡，也不说明口感软硬。

examples.en: The sole has a delicate flavour, so we serve the lemon sauce on the side.
examples.zh: 这款鳎鱼风味清雅，所以我们把柠檬酱放在旁边。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: To spoon or pour fat, cooking juices or another liquid over food during cooking, often over meat in a pan or oven.
definition.zh: 在烹调过程中把热油脂、肉汁或其他液体反复淋到食物表面，常见于煎肉和烤禽。butter-basted 表示以黄油淋浇；这与上桌后才浇酱的动作不同。

examples.en: We baste the steak with butter and thyme while it cooks.
examples.zh: 煎制牛排时，我们会反复淋上黄油和百里香汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: In common US kitchen usage, to cook or brown food close beneath intense direct heat; often called grilling in British English.
definition.zh: 美式厨房常指把食物放在强烈上方热源下炙烤，使其烹熟或表面上色；英式英语常用 grill 表达这种做法。介绍菜单时说明热源和处理方式，避免与炭火烧烤混淆。

examples.en: The salmon is broiled under high heat and served with lemon butter.
examples.zh: 这份三文鱼用强烈上火炙烤，配柠檬黄油。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
Overhead heat is the common modern US kitchen sense; grill is not added as an alias because its regional meanings vary.

definition.en: To heat sugars until they develop caramel colour and flavour; caramelize is the US spelling.
definition.zh: 加热糖分，使其产生焦糖的色泽与香味；美式拼写为 caramelize。焦糖化不等于所有上色：肉类表面的褐变常涉及糖与氨基成分的美拉德反应，两者应区分。

sources.title: Institute of Culinary Education — know your ingredients: dairy

examples.en: We caramelise the sugar on the crème brûlée just before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前，我们会把焦糖布丁表面的糖烤成焦糖脆壳。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
Caramelisation is distinguished from Maillard browning; no single universal caramelisation temperature is taught.

definition.en: To treat food for preservation and flavour, commonly with salt and sometimes sugar, drying or smoking; curing need not involve heat-cooking.
definition.zh: 通过盐腌等处理改变食物风味、质地并用于保藏，具体做法可能涉及糖、风干或烟熏。菜单上的 cured 不保证经过加热，也不同于单纯用调味汁短时间腌味的 marinated。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — cured salmon recipes

examples.en: Our salmon is cured with salt, sugar and dill, then thinly sliced.
examples.zh: 我们的三文鱼用盐、糖和莳萝腌制，然后切成薄片。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
No shelf-life, pathogen-elimination or cooked-through guarantee is inferred from the word cured.

definition.en: To cut flesh away from fish or meat bones; the noun also names the resulting boneless piece.
definition.zh: 作动词指沿骨骼把鱼肉或肉切下、整理成肉片；作名词指这样的去骨肉块。菜单上的 filleted 描述处理方式，不宜据此向客人承诺绝无细小残刺。

examples.en: The chef fillets the sea bass before pan-frying it.
examples.zh: 主厨先把海鲈鱼去骨取片，再下锅香煎。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: To coat food with a layer that gives it shine, using ingredients such as syrup, egg wash or a reduced sauce.
definition.zh: 在食物表面形成有光泽的薄层，可用糖浆、蛋液或浓缩酱汁，既用于甜点，也用于肉类和蔬菜。glazed 不一定是甜味，更不等于所有浇在盘中的酱汁。

examples.en: The carrots are glazed with a little honey and butter.
examples.zh: 这份胡萝卜裹上了少量蜂蜜和黄油形成的亮面薄汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: To cut vegetables or other food into slender, even strips resembling matchsticks; also used to describe that cut.
definition.zh: 把蔬菜等食材切成细长而较均匀的丝条，常用于沙拉、配菜或装饰。julienned carrots 指切成细丝的胡萝卜；它说明刀工形状，并不说明生熟或调味。

examples.en: The salad includes julienned carrots and cucumber with a light dressing.
examples.zh: 这款沙拉有胡萝卜丝和黄瓜丝，配清淡的沙拉汁。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: To leave food in a seasoned mixture to develop flavour before further preparation; the mixture is called a marinade.
definition.zh: 让肉、鱼或蔬菜在调味混合物中放置一段时间以增加风味；配方可能含油、酸味液体、香草或香料。marinade 通常指腌料本身，marinate 指腌味动作。

examples.en: We marinate the chicken in yogurt, lemon and spices before grilling.
examples.zh: 烧烤之前，我们先用酸奶、柠檬和香料给鸡肉腌味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
Marinade is not a lookup alias here, preserving the useful noun-versus-verb distinction.

definition.en: To cook in liquid held just below a full boil, with gentle movement rather than vigorous bubbling.
definition.zh: 把液体维持在接近沸腾的温和状态，让食物慢慢煮制，常用于汤、酱汁和炖菜。与剧烈翻滚的 boil 不同；simmer 说明加热状态，不等于某一种固定炖菜。

examples.en: The tomato sauce simmers gently with garlic and basil.
examples.zh: 这款番茄酱会与蒜和罗勒一起保持微沸慢煮。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.

definition.en: To expose food to smoke for flavour and, in some preparations, preservation; smoked describes food treated this way.
definition.zh: 让食物接触烟气以增加风味，某些做法也用于保藏。菜单上的 smoked 通常说明进行了烟熏处理，而 smoky 只描述味道或香气；具体生熟状态需看实际工艺。

examples.en: We smoke the cheese over wood chips for a gentle smoky flavour.
examples.zh: 我们用木屑烟熏这款奶酪，让它带上柔和的烟熏风味。

entries.originalContext: SOMM100 English Library · classic menu expansion to 300+ dishes and practical culinary vocabulary · 2026-10-27
reviewNotes: Source-reviewed on 2026-10-27. Definitions and service examples are original teaching text; examples describe an illustrative preparation.
The food-preparation sense is taught, not tobacco use; no universal preservation or heat-cooking result is claimed.
